raw.description:
About Lead For America

Lead For America (LFA) is dedicated to providing place-based service opportunities to local individuals to help mission-driven organizations advance solutions that are informed by place and responsive to community. The American Connection Corps (ACC), launched by LFA in 2021, is an AmeriCorps service program focused on closing the digital divide in digitally disconnected communities. Supported by a broad coalition of partners including AmeriCorps and major corporations, ACC has members serving in 30+ states across the country.

LFA is a growing, nationally distributed organization that manages multiple programs, funding sources, grants, and operational partnerships. The Finance team plays a critical role in ensuring that LFA's financial systems, records, and processes are accurate, timely, compliant, and supportive of organizational decision-making.

Department Context

The Finance team provides the financial infrastructure that enables Lead For America to advance its mission responsibly and sustainably. The team oversees accounting, budgeting, financial reporting, grants and contracts, compliance, payroll and benefits administration, and other financial operations.

The Staff Accountant is an important member of this team, supporting the day-to-day accounting functions that keep LFA's financial records accurate and current. This role works across the organization to ensure that transactions are properly documented, expenses are appropriately coded and supported, and financial information is maintained in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), LFA policies, grant requirements, and audit standards.

Role Expectations

The Staff Accountant reports to the Controller and supports the routine accounting operations of Lead For America. This role is responsible for accurate and timely transaction processing, reconciliations, expense management, financial documentation, and other accounting activities that support the monthly close and broader Finance function.

The Staff Accountant is expected to:

  • Maintain accurate and timely financial records and documentation
  • Execute routine accounting processes with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail
  • Support the Controller in maintaining a timely and effective monthly close process
  • Apply LFA financial policies, accounting procedures, and internal controls consistently
  • Collaborate effectively with staff across Programs, Development, Operations, Community Partnerships & Talent, and other departments
  • Protect the confidentiality and integrity of financial information
  • Identify discrepancies, missing information, and process gaps and work proactively to resolve them

What You'll Do

1. Accounting Operations & Financial Transactions — 40%

  • Record and maintain day-to-day financial transactions in LFA's accounting and financial systems.
  • Review and accurately code financial transactions to the appropriate accounts, programs, departments, grants, and funding sources.
  • Process and maintain accounts payable transactions, including vendor invoices, bills, and supporting documentation.
  • Support accounts receivable activities, including recording receipts and maintaining appropriate documentation for incoming funds.
  • Update financial systems and internal Finance communication channels with relevant banking and financial activity.
  • Ensure financial transactions include appropriate supporting documentation and comply with LFA policies and procedures.
  • Review W-9s and maintain vendor documentation to support 1099 reporting and other compliance requirements.
  • Support the administration and accuracy of employee expense and reimbursement processes, including reviewing expense reports for appropriate coding, documentation, and policy compliance.
  • Provide timely support to staff regarding expense submissions, corrections, missing documentation, and other routine Finance questions.
  • Assist with credit card and purchasing processes, including transaction review and reconciliation.
  • Work cross-functionally with staff to resolve financial discrepancies and obtain missing information.
  • Complete assigned tasks in LFA's project management systems to support accounting and Finance processes.

2. Reconciliations, Month-End Close & Financial Reporting Support — 25%

  • Prepare routine bank, credit card, and other account reconciliations.
  • Investigate and resolve discrepancies identified through reconciliation processes.
  • Support the Controller with the monthly and year-end close processes.
  • Prepare and maintain schedules and supporting documentation for balance sheet accounts.
  • Assist with accruals, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, and other routine accounting entries as assigned.
  • Ensure transactions are recorded in the appropriate accounting period.
  • Review financial data for completeness and accuracy and flag unusual or potentially incorrect activity.
  • Support the preparation of internal financial reports and analyses.
  • Maintain organized and audit-ready financial records and documentation.
  • Assist with financial reporting related to programs, grants, and restricted funds as directed by the Controller.

3. Grants, Compliance & Audit Support — 15%

  • Support the Finance team in maintaining accurate financial records related to restricted and unrestricted funding.
  • Assist with tracking and documenting grant-related financial activity and expenses.
  • Work with the Controller and Grants team to ensure financial information is available and properly documented for grant reporting.
  • Support the preparation of schedules and documentation requested by external auditors, funders, and other stakeholders.
  • Maintain organized financial files and supporting documentation in accordance with LFA's record retention policies.
  • Assist with annual audit and tax preparation activities, including gathering requested documentation and responding to routine information requests.
  • Support compliance with GAAP, LFA policies, grant requirements, and applicable nonprofit financial reporting requirements.
  • Identify and communicate potential compliance issues or inconsistencies to the Controller.

4. Finance Administration & Organizational Support — 10%

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date Finance documentation, files, and records.
  • Assist with maintaining vendor, banking, insurance, and other financial documentation.
  • Support Finance-related onboarding for new staff, including expense management and financial systems.
  • Help document and improve Finance processes, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Participate in Finance projects that improve efficiency, accuracy, reporting, or organizational financial management.
  • Provide ad hoc accounting and financial support as needed.
  • Collaborate with other departments to strengthen understanding and consistent application of LFA's financial processes.

5. Organizational Requirements - 10%

In addition to the responsibilities unique to the Staff Accountant role, all LFA team members devote a portion of their time to supporting strategic efforts across the organization that advance our mission and organizational priorities. Activities include but are not limited to:

  • Compliance for org-wide administration - expense reporting, benefits, KPI tracking
  • Taking part in additional organizational initiatives, priorities, and responsibilities, as needed.
  • Supporting organizational initiatives and priorities outside of an individual's primary department, as needed.
  • Participating in organizational meetings, retreats, trainings, and team-building activities.
  • Supporting LFA programs, events, and convenings when appropriate.
  • Contributing to a collaborative, inclusive, and mission-driven organizational culture.
  • Participating in cross-functional projects and problem-solving efforts.
  • Taking on additional responsibilities as needed to support LFA's evolving organizational priorities.

What Success Looks Like

  • Financial transactions are recorded accurately, timely, and consistently.
  • Bank, credit card, and other reconciliations are completed accurately and on schedule.
  • Monthly close activities are completed efficiently and with appropriate documentation.
  • Expense and reimbursement processes are accurate, timely, and compliant with LFA policies.
  • Financial records are organized, complete, and audit-ready.
  • Grant and program financial information is appropriately documented and supported.
  • Finance questions and issues are addressed responsively and professionally.
  • The Controller has reliable support for day-to-day accounting operations and financial reporting.
  • Finance processes become increasingly efficient, documented, and consistent.
  • Staff across LFA experience the Finance team as a responsive and trusted operational partner.

Requirements

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in accounting, finance, bookkeeping, or a related field.
  • Experience with general ledger accounting and routine accounting processes.
  • Demonstrated experience with bank and/or account reconciliations.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to manage confidential financial information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and competing priorities.
  • Proficiency with spreadsheets, particularly Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Ability to learn and effectively use accounting, expense management, and other financial systems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across departments and communicate financial processes clearly to non-finance colleagues.
  • Ability to identify discrepancies, investigate issues, and follow through to resolution.
  • Commitment to Lead For America's mission and to responsible stewardship of organizational resources.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a nonprofit or 501(c)(3) organization.
  • Experience with grant-funded organizations and/or fund accounting.
  • Experience with nonprofit accounting and restricted funding.
  • Experience supporting an annual financial audit.
  • Experience with accounting platforms.
  • Experience with an expense management system.
  • Familiarity with AmeriCorps, government grants, or other federally funded programs.
  • Familiarity with GAAP and nonprofit financial reporting requirements.
  • Experience documenting or improving accounting processes and internal controls.

Benefits

Compensation & Benefits

We offer a competitive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of our team, including:

  • Partially employer-covered healthcare premiums
  • 401(k) matching
  • Unlimited paid time off (PTO)
  • Technology stipend
  • Home office stipend

Salary Range

The anticipated salary range for this position is $60,000–$70,000, with starting compensation determined based on the scope of the role, relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.

We believe in equitable and transparent compensation practices. As part of our ongoing performance management and compensation review process, salaries may increase over time based on factors such as demonstrated performance, increased experience and responsibilities, inflation, and organizational growth.

raw.excerpt: Who we areAt CloudFactory, we are a mission-driven team passionate about unlocking the disruptive potential of AI for the world.
raw.description:
Who we are

At CloudFactory, we are a mission-driven team passionate about unlocking the disruptive potential of AI for the world. By combining advanced technology with a global network of talented experts, we make unusable data usable and inference reliable and trustworthy, driving real-world business value at scale.

More than just a workplace, we're a global community founded on strong relationships and the belief that meaningful work transforms lives. Our commitment to earning, learning, and serving fuels everything we do, as we strive to connect one million people to meaningful work and build leaders worth following.

Our culture

At CloudFactory, we believe in building a workplace where everyone feels empowered, valued, and inspired to bring their authentic selves to work. We are:

  • Mission-driven: we focus on creating economic and social impact.
  • People-centric: we care deeply about our team's growth, well-being, and sense of belonging.
  • Innovative: we embrace change and find better ways to do things, together.
  • Globally connected: we foster collaboration between diverse cultures and perspectives.

Location: Spain
Project type: One-time paid project
Time commitment: Approximately 1–2 hours
Compensation: $75 for completing the project activity

About the opportunity

CloudFactory is looking for participants to support a short-term transaction validation project that we are administering on behalf of a global payments processing company.

The project is designed to help evaluate the accuracy of how payment transactions are matched to individuals.

As a participant, you'll review a set of recent payment transactions and indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself.

How it works

If selected for the project:

  1. You'll provide the email address(es) you use with selected merchants, subscriptions, apps, or online accounts.
  2. Our payments processing client will use those email address(es) to identify payment transactions it believes are associated with you and securely provide a list of those transactions for the project.
  3. You'll be presented with approximately 50 recent transactions from the last 3 months through the designated project platform. The information shown may include details such as the merchant name, date, amount, payment method, card identifier, and card issuer to help you recognize each transaction.
  4. You'll indicate whether or not you recognize each transaction as one you made yourself and, where helpful, add a short note.

The activity is expected to take approximately 1–2 hours.

You will not be asked to provide or upload your own transaction history, bank statements, full card number, online banking login credentials, banking password, PIN, or CVV.

Please note that this is a data validation activity only.

Requirements

To participate, you must:

  • Be 18 years of age or older.
  • Currently reside in Spain.
  • Be an active debit and/or credit card user.
  • Have made purchases or payments within the last three months across a variety of merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be able to recognize your own recent purchases and transactions.
  • Have access to the email address(es) you use with the merchants and services included in our eligibility questionnaire.
  • Be comfortable providing those email address(es) if selected for the project.
  • Be willing to review approximately 50 transactions and confirm whether or not you recognize them as your own.

Privacy and consent

Because this project involves personal and financial transaction information, privacy and informed consent are essential.

Before participating, you'll receive our Participant Consent & Confidentiality Terms, which explain how your personal information and transaction data will be used and processed as part of the project.

If you qualify and provide your consent, relevant payment transactions will be securely provided to CloudFactory by the end-customer and made available to you through the designated project platform for validation.

You may withdraw your consent and participation in accordance with the terms provided to you before the project begins.

Interested? Complete our short eligibility questionnaire to be considered for this paid project.

raw.description:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.

MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.

This role will be based remotely in Germany.

As an ideal candidate, you will have:

  • Ideally 8 to 11 years of related experience in a customer facing role, with 5 to 7 years of experience in pre-sales with enterprise software
  • Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity
  • Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem
  • Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership
  • Ability to strategize with sales teams and provide recommendations on how to drive a multi-threaded account strategy, aligning other MongoDB and ecosystem resources to move towards a mutually beneficial account plan
  • The ability to travel up to 25%
  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

You may also have:

  • Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers
  • Experience with database programming and data models
  • Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
  • Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks
  • Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message
  • A MongoDB Certification
  • A Cloud Provider Certification

What you do at MongoDB:

In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:

  • Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB
  • Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders
  • Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the sales team to drive account success through account planning, opportunity prioritization/qualification and pipeline generation strategy, while taking ownership of the technical aspects (including but not limited to technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentations, sizing and documentation)
  • Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through self-driven technical initiatives, participation in events such as industry trade shows and account-based marketing events
  • Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction
  • Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members
  • Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends

What you will learn:

MongoDB Product Suite Mastery:

  • Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
  • Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
  • Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly

Market-Relevant Technologies:

  • Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
  • Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes

Modern Architecture Design:

  • Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security
  • Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space

Sales Techniques and Soft Skills:

  • Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding
  • Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling

Industry Insights:

  • Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

raw.excerpt: The bright side of mortgages nesto is Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.
raw.description:
The bright side of mortgages

nesto is Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.

About Us

As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.

Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Fast, simple, and fully digital, nesto has been recognized as CLA Lender of the Year for three consecutive years. That's the bright side of mortgages.

Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands—CMLS, nesto, and Nesto Cloud—our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services. Learn more at:

Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Where you sit.

You'll be joining the Origination stream, the product area responsible for the end-to-end mortgage journey, covering self-serve and advisor-supported application flows, underwriting, decisioning, and funding.

This is a Senior PM role where part of your mandate is to help shape and own your specific substream within origination. You'll work closely with the stream lead, and together you'll define the boundaries of your focus area based on your strengths, the team's needs, and where the biggest opportunities are. It's a rare chance to have real influence over your own scope from day one.

Your closest collaborators will be engineering teams building on Nesto Cloud, mortgage operations and underwriting experts who live inside these processes daily, and the brokers and advisors who depend on these tools to serve clients.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Act as one of the primary origination subject-matter experts for your substream, deeply understanding end-to-end origination processes, regulatory requirements, and operational realities.
  • Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and feature prioritization for your area, ensuring it reflects real-world origination requirements, operational efficiencies, and compliance considerations.
  • Identify and assess the impact of new lending features, regulatory changes, and origination workflow evolutions to help shape product direction and support strategic decisions.
  • Work closely with engineering, design, QA, operations, and compliance to validate designs and proposed solutions, ensuring they align with origination best practices and industry standards.
  • Support the backlog refinement process by prioritizing origination-related epics and stories, balancing customer experience, operational needs, and technical feasibility.
  • Participate in release planning, UAT, and pre-launch readiness to ensure origination use cases are fully supported, edge cases are addressed, and downstream impacts are understood.
  • Conduct research on industry trends, evolving regulations, origination technologies, and competitor approaches, bringing insights to guide product evolution.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation of origination processes, scenarios, requirements, and system behaviours to support product teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Act as the go-to expert for your origination workflows, answering questions, supporting issue triage, and ensuring the product supports exceptional origination experiences across all lending products.

AI-Augmented Ways of Working

  • Actively use AI tools (Cursor, Claude, Figma AI, Gemini, and others) to accelerate your PM workflow from discovery through delivery: synthesizing research, prototyping ideas, and measuring results.
  • Don't wait for a perfect process to test a hypothesis. Use the tools available to you to get to answers faster, whether that means building a rough prototype, running a quick experiment, or drafting a solution to pressure-test with users before it becomes a roadmap item.
  • Comfortable going beyond traditional PM boundaries when the situation calls for it, the best people here don't hand off and wait, they stay close to the work and use every tool at their disposal to move it forward.
  • Stay ahead of how AI is reshaping mortgage origination and bring informed recommendations to the roadmap.
  • Share what you discover. How you work should make the people around you better.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The profile.

  • 5-7+ years of hands-on experience in product management, ideally with exposure to mortgage origination, lending, or a closely adjacent regulated financial services environment.
  • Understanding of end-to-end origination functions from application flows, document collection, underwriting, credit decisioning to compliance checkpoints, and funding processes.
  • Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements related to mortgage and consumer lending, including provincial regulations, OSFI guidelines, insurance requirements, and reporting obligations.
  • Experience working with origination platforms, LOS systems, or lending technology, with the ability to translate operational needs into functional system requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, design, operations, compliance, and QA teams.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills with an ability to anticipate downstream impacts and foresee edge cases in origination workflows.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex origination concepts clearly to non-experts in Product and Engineering.
  • Proven, active fluency with AI tools across your PM workflow : discovery, testing, documentation, analysis, and measurement. We will ask you specifically how you use them.

PREFERRED BUT NOT A MUST

  • Experience with other lending products such as HELOC, personal loans, private lending, reverse mortgages, or construction financing.
  • Familiarity with broker and advisor-facing workflows and the nuances of supported versus self-serve client journeys.
  • Exposure to AI or ML-assisted decisioning, document intelligence, or automation in a financial services context.

YOU SHOULDN'T APPLY IF
Be honest with yourself.

  • You're only comfortable in a well-defined product area. This role requires you to help shape your own scope: ambiguity is the starting condition, not an exception.
  • You treat AI tools as a curiosity rather than a daily accelerant.
  • You hand off a PRD and consider your job done. Ownership here runs from discovery all the way through to measuring results in production.
  • You don't thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and sometimes ambiguous environment.
  • You are not open to experimentation and continuous improvement.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

How we get to know each other.

  • Recruiter Screen – 30 minutes
  • Discovery Call with Director of Product – 30 minutes
  • Take-home Assignment followed by Presentation and Q&A – 60 minutes
  • Final Stakeholder Interview – 45 minutes
  • Criminal Record and Reference Checks + Offer

Why You'll Love Working Here

We believe great people do their best work when they're supported professionally, personally, and financially. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to help you thrive at every stage of your career.

  • Competitive Rewards — Competitive compensation, performance incentives (where applicable), and recognition for your contributions.
  • Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, Health & Wellness Spending Accounts (where applicable), telemedicine, Employee Assistance Programs, and mental health support for you and your family.
  • Time to Recharge — Generous vacation (4 weeks), floater days, and statutory holidays to help you recharge.
  • Planning for the Future — RRSP matching to support your long-term financial wellbeing.
  • Family Support — Enhanced maternity and parental leave top-up programs.
  • Learning & Growth — Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.
  • Tools for Success — Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Nesto Group, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, members of racialized communities, women, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, we are committed to working with you to meet your needs.

raw.description:
ARE YOU OUR NEXT EMAIL DESIGNER?
Our client, YOCTO (yocto.agency), is seeking a highly skilled and results-oriented Email Designer to join their team for a full-time remote position. As they continue to expand, we are looking for a talented individual who can bring their expertise in DTC email design and marketing to drive conversion and click-through rates.
Your core role and responsibilities:
  • Design captivating and visually appealing emails using Figma, ensuring they align with brand guidelines and effectively communicate key messages.
  • ClickUp Task Management for reviewing daily briefs and managing tasks efficiently.
  • Continuously research and stay updated on email design, branding, and user experience (UX) trends in the e-commerce space to enhance existing email templates.
  • Take charge of the visual and creative direction for YOCTO as an agency, maintaining consistent branding across all communications.
  • Occasionally handle ad hoc design tasks for the agency, such as creating PowerPoint presentations.
  • Collaborate with clients to develop Figma Boards based on their Brand Book, utilizing it as a constructor to rapidly iterate new versions of on-brand emails.

Our client is a Singapore-based fintech group with regional hubs in Lithuania and Dubai, and operations in Thailand, Indonesia, and the Philippines. Their operation is fully legal and compliant, with licenses in multiple countries and jurisdictions globally. Via their flagship product, they offer a cross-border payment solution infrastructure for money transfer operators, local banks, and corporates. With their mobile application, their retail customers and SMEs across Southeast Asia can send money to their families, friends, and business partners around the world.

﻿

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced and results-oriented Senior Director of Sales to lead our client’s global sales strategy within the Money Transfer Operator (MTO) and Payment Service Provider (PSP) sectors. This critical leadership role will be responsible for driving significant revenue growth, managing their global sales team, and expanding their footprint into key international markets. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of the MTO/PSP landscape, a proven track record of exceeding sales targets, and an extensive network within major banks, MTOs, and payment service providers.

Job Type: Full Time

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive sales leadership experience, with a significant focus on the Money Transfer Operator (MTO) and/or Payment Service Provider (PSP) sectors.
  • Demonstrated experience with major banks, MTOs (e.g., Western Union, MoneyGram, Ria), and prominent payment service providers is essential.
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding sales quotas and driving substantial revenue growth in complex, global environments.
  • Extensive and verifiable network of relationships with key decision-makers and influencers within the MTO and PSP industries.
  • Deep understanding of the global payments landscape, including regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and technological trends (e.g., real-time payments, blockchain, open banking).
  • Exceptional leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire, motivate, and develop a high-performing sales force across diverse geographies.
  • Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication (written and verbal), and presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel internationally as required.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field; MBA preferred.
  • Strongly Preferred: Have client list ready to integrate

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Sales Leadership: Develop, implement, and refine comprehensive global sales strategies for the MTO and PSP segments to achieve ambitious revenue targets and market share growth.
  • Revenue Management: Own the global MTO/PSP revenue pipeline, forecasting, and P&L. Implement effective pricing strategies and negotiate high-value contracts to maximize profitability.
  • Global Market Expansion: Identify and prioritize new market opportunities within the MTO and PSP ecosystems. Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for international expansion.
  • Team Leadership & Development: Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing global sales team. Foster a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. Provide ongoing coaching, performance management, and career development opportunities.
  • Client Relationship Management: Cultivate and maintain strong, strategic relationships with key decision-makers within major banks, MTOs, and PSPs globally. Act as a trusted advisor and thought leader in the industry.
  • Partnership Development: Identify, evaluate, and forge strategic partnerships that accelerate market penetration and enhance our product/service offerings.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay abreast of industry trends, competitive landscape, regulatory changes, and technological advancements within the MTO and PSP space to inform sales strategies and product development.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, marketing, operations, and legal teams to ensure alignment of sales strategies with overall business objectives and to effectively bring new solutions to market.
  • Reporting & Analysis: Provide regular, insightful reports on sales performance, market trends, and pipeline status to senior leadership. Utilize data to drive informed decision-making.

About Aretum

DHS Suitability Required

Aretum is a mission-driven organization committed to delivering innovative, technology-enabled solutions to our customers across defense, civilian, and homeland security sectors. Our teams work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and transformation, helping agencies solve their most critical challenges. We believe in investing in our people and creating a culture where collaboration, inclusion, and professional growth are at the forefront.

Job Summary

Aretum is seeking a Junior Accountant to support daily accounting operations by preparing journal entries, performing account reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting to ensure accuracy and compliance with federal accounting requirements. The role requires someone who is detail-oriented, analytical, and collaborative, with the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies while supporting month-end close activities and maintaining accurate financial records.

Due to the nature of our work as a federal consulting organization, employees may be expected to handle Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and must adhere to applicable safeguarding and compliance requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Apply Federal Accounting Standards Advisory Board (FASAB) standards and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) to analyze, reconcile, and report intergovernmental transactions.
  • Prepare financial schedules supporting elimination entries and resolve trading partner discrepancies.
  • Prepare and post U.S. Standard General Ledger (USSGL)-compliant journal entries to ensure accurate financial reporting.
  • Review payroll accounting transactions prior to posting to verify accuracy and compliance.
  • Prepare payroll accruals and reconcile payroll disbursements from multiple payroll sources to U.S. Treasury disbursements.
  • Identify, research, and resolve payroll accounting discrepancies, preparing corrective journal entries as needed.
  • Reconcile Fund Balance with Treasury (FBWT) to agency financial reporting and investigate variances.
  • Document reconciliation findings, recommend corrective actions, and prepare USSGL-compliant journal entries to resolve identified discrepancies.
  • Ensure all reconciliations, journal entries, and supporting documentation comply with federal accounting standards, agency policies, and reporting requirements.

Requirements

  • BS and 2 (+) years' experience or equivalent education and experience.
  • Experienced accounting professional with strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
  • Proven team player with experience working in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.
  • Experience supporting federal accounting operations, including general ledger activities and monthly financial close processes.
  • Experience preparing and analyzing financial statements.
  • Ability to interpret and apply U.S. Treasury USSGL accounting scenarios or comparable private-sector accounting standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Experience developing, documenting, and communicating financial management policies, procedures, and operational guidance.
  • Ability to implement and support changes to financial management practices and financial system operations.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to analyze complex financial data and recommend effective solutions.

Preferred

  • CPA

Travel Requirements

This is a remote position; however, occasional travel may be required based on project needs, client meetings, team collaboration events, or training sessions. Travel is expected to be less than 5% and will be communicated in advance whenever possible.

EEO Statement

Aretum is committed to fostering a workplace rooted in excellence, integrity, and equal opportunity for all. We adhere to merit-based hiring practices, ensuring that all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, skills, and ability to perform the job, without preference or consideration of factors unrelated to job performance.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Aretum complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws.

We are proud to support our nation’s veterans and military families, providing career opportunities that honor their service and experience.

If you require reasonable accommodation during the hiring process due to a disability, please contact for assistance.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

U.S. Work Authorization

Due to federal contract requirements, only U.S. citizens are eligible for this position. This position supports a federal government contract and requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability Determination, depending on the agency’s background investigation requirements.

Benefits

  • Salary Range: $90,000–$105,000 annually. Final compensation will be determined based on factors including education, experience, qualifications, skills, and applicable contract requirements.
  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k)
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Paid Time Off
  • Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity)
  • Short Term & Long-Term Disability
  • Training & Development

raw.description:
We have a fantastic opportunity for a Group Head of Learning & Development, Communications and Partnership Engagement to join our Senior Leadership Team. This role will be remote with national travel.

Reporting directly to the Group Chief People Officer you will be responsible for leading on EMED Group’s strategy for learning and organisational development, internal and external communications, partnership engagement and social values, ensuring these areas are aligned to operational and strategic priorities to support the capability, leadership culture and social impact needed to deliver exceptional patient care, operational excellence and sustainable growth.

Benefits for the role include

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual car allowance
  • Performance related bonus
  • Private Healthcare
  • 33 days annual leave (inclusive of bank holidays) with the option to purchase additional leave through salary sacrifice.
  • Life Assurance
  • 24/7 online/telephone GP Consultation and access to prescriptions.
  • 2nd opinion medical support following diagnosis or where a colleague is on a treatment pathway.
  • Cash-plan benefits, providing colleagues the option of protecting themselves in case of illness and recuperation, including dental, optical, chiropody.
  • Access to mental health and physiotherapy consultations.
  • Access to legal advice on domestic issues e.g. motoring offences, wills and probate, and personal injury.
  • Long Service Recognition Scheme – recognising colleagues for their continued service after 5 years and at 5-year intervals with an increase in annual leave.

Role Responsibilities

  • Develop, lead and implement the Group Learning & Development Strategy, aligned to EMED’s People Strategy, organisational objectives and future capability requirements.
  • Partner with the Chief People Officer, Executive Leadership Team, senior leaders and operational leaders to identify capability gaps and design learning solutions that support business priorities.
  • Design and oversee leadership and management development programmes for Managers, including the Manager Acceleration Programme and associated pathways.
  • Lead succession planning and talent development activity in partnership with HR Business Partners and senior leaders, ensuring learning supports future leadership pipelines.
  • Work collaboratively with the Training team, clinical, quality, governance, safeguarding, information governance, health and safety and operational colleagues to ensure learning responsibilities are clearly defined and support safe, compliant and high-quality patient care.
  • Maximise effective use of the Apprenticeship Levy and develop apprenticeship pathways that support frontline colleagues, managers and senior leaders.
  • Promote professional qualifications and structured development routes that enhance capability, retention and career progression.
  • Lead the development and effective delivery of internal communications channels that connect colleagues with corporate news, organisational priorities, celebrations, successes and key messages across EMED Group.
  • Work with senior leaders, operational teams and enabling functions to ensure internal communications support engagement, change, culture, colleague voice and shared organisational identity.
  • Provide leadership for internal social value activity delivered through the EMED Foundation, ensuring activity is aligned to EMED’s organisational values, community impact objectives and wider people strategy.
  • Support the leadership of EMED Foundation activity via the Trustees to deliver campaigns, colleague involvement and associated governance to ensure social value initiatives are visible, meaningful and connected to local and national priorities.
  • Work in conjunction with the Talent Resourcing team to identify and develop social value, employability, outreach and partnership activity that supports attraction, resourcing, community engagement and inclusive workforce development.
  • Build effective internal and external partnerships that support the delivery of social value commitments, including charitable relationships, community stakeholders, education partners and resourcing-related initiatives.
  • Develop opportunities to embed lived experience within colleague learning and induction, including investment in a patient-focused video that helps colleagues understand the experience of being a dialysis patient. This should include scoping an outline budget for partners to work within and ensuring the content supports empathy, awareness and patient-centred practice.
  • Work with charitable and social value partners to strengthen EMED’s external value proposition, including exploring how partner insight and content can support social value development within bids, particularly where increased weighting may be expected in future commissioning and procurement processes.
  • Planning, prioritisation, budget awareness and strategic leadership of the Learning & Development function, with potential future responsibility for team leadership as the function evolves.

Do you have what it takes?

  • Communication with Impact – articulates strategy to influence stakeholders, communicates decisively during uncertainty, inspires confidence and ensures ownership and clarity when delivering messages across teams, stakeholders, external partners and the wider business.
  • Agile Thinking – adjusts long-term plans and organisational strategies in response to changing needs, promotes collaboration across teams and proactively manages risks through experimentation, learning and innovation.
  • Delivering Results – aligns team efforts with organisational objectives, establishes clear metrics, integrates financial understanding into decision making and adapts strategies using insight to deliver commercial and operational impact.
  • Encouraging Ownership and Teamwork – empowers team members by assigning responsibility based on strengths, breaks down silos, promotes shared accountability and actively mentors others to strengthen capability.
  • Customer Focussed – ensures the organisation understands and responds to evolving customer, patient and service user needs, integrating their perspectives into strategic decision making and cross-functional delivery.
  • Delivering Clarity of Vision – develops and communicates a compelling vision for learning and organisational capability, aligning it with EMED’s strategic priorities, future workforce needs and long-term objectives.
  • Investing in Talent – actively leads succession planning, develops talent pipelines, establishes mentoring and sponsorship approaches and invests in leadership development to strengthen organisational capability.
  • Leading with Influence – engages and influences key stakeholders at a strategic level, builds credibility as a thought leader, and leads learning, engagement, social value and change initiatives that secure support for transformation and long-term success.
  • Leading Change – communicates the case for change, builds confidence through uncertainty, addresses resistance constructively and fosters a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and learning.

About Us

EMED Group is an established healthcare logistics provider that enables access to health and social care through our four specialist divisions. We are one of the largest health and care partners to the NHS with 4,000 colleagues across over 60 bases UK-wide.

EMED Group is committed to pro-actively improving the wellbeing of our communities by providing access to vital health and social care services across the UK.

EMED Group are committed to providing services for our patients, service users, clients, and community and is supported by employees with an increasing variety of backgrounds. To do this effectively it is essential that we promote equality and embrace diversity and inclusion and treat all of our employees, patients, service users and clients with dignity and respect.

EMED Group is committed to encouraging equality, diversity and inclusion among our workforce, and eliminating unlawful discrimination, with our aim being to be truly representative of all sections of society and our clients, and for each employee to feel respected, valued and able to give their best.

EMED Group are committed to providing equal opportunities and we endeavour to provide an inclusive and safe working culture for all.

Preferred

  • Experience with regional-language AI data annotation, labeling, or bilingual evaluation.
  • Skills in transcription and localization, such as MTPE, subtitling, or OCR correction.

Descrição da vaga

O Grupo Boticário é líder de Beleza no Brasil. Unimos tecnologia, varejo, logística e soluções digitais (com A Mooz) para transformar dados em desejo e conectar toda a nossa cadeia de valor. Acreditamos que a beleza pode e deve inspirar mudanças.

Construa o futuro da beleza com a gente. Vamos juntos?

O que é o nosso time de Venda Direta?

No time de Venda Direta temos a missão de trazer beleza para a vida das nossas representantes. Entendemos a venda direta também como forma de empoderar quem sonha em empreender, e por isso queremos a melhor experiência possível para as pessoas empreendedoras. Em um mundo cada vez mais digital, transformar esse canal pela tecnologia é como construímos um ecossistema de beleza.

O produto em que você vai atuar:

No Grupo Boticário, Inteligência Artificial Generativa é pilar estratégico. Você irá atuar no time de Plataforma de Agentes: plataforma centralizada para criar, gerir e executar agentes LLM nos canais de negócio do GB. Sua missão será criar uma plataforma de construção de agentes para dar autonomia ao uso de Gen AI em times funcionais. Nosso foco é garantir que chegue até os diversos clientes do Grupo Boticário as melhores soluções envolvendo IA, alavancando resultados tangíveis para a empresa.

Como será o seu dia

  • Em parceria com o Tech Lead, você ajudará a materializar a visão técnica dos produtos, garantindo a escrita de código limpo, algoritmos otimizados e participando ativamente de revisões técnicas para manter o baixo débito técnico da squad.
  • Implementar e evoluir a interface da Plataforma de Agentes com produto e design.
  • Sua missão envolve executar com excelência garantindo a qualidade do produto: testes, acessibilidade, tagueamento/analytics da jornada, observabilidade no front, testes.
  • Implementar as melhores soluções de frontend e backend para nossos usuários, visando sempre a qualidade, performance, melhores práticas de programação, simplicidade e melhor experiência de uso;
  • Desenvolver, realizar testes unitários, implantar e monitorar o que foi desenvolvido, além de garantir a qualidade e boas práticas de programação;
  • Aprimorar aplicações identificando oportunidades de melhoria, fazer recomendações, projetar e implementar sistemas;
  • Participar ativamente das decisões na implementação dos produtos, demonstrando sentimento de dono;
  • Manter, melhorar e revisar códigos existentes através de Code Review e Pair Programming;
  • Manter bom relacionamento buscando soluções inovadoras para os projetos;
  • Manter documentação atualizada;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa, usando de boa comunicação;
  • Se apaixonar pela resolução de problemas e busca de soluções viáveis.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento web utilizando React
  • Sólida experiência com testes automatizados (Unitário, integração, E2E);
  • Experiência com Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD), GitHub, GitHub Actions e Sonar.
  • Conhecimento da plataforma AWS.
  • Familiaridade com desenvolvimento seguro (avaliações de segurança, vulnerabilidades, atuação em incidentes, etc);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis como Scrum e Kanban;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional, multi-linguagem e colaborativo, de maneira autónoma;
  • Pragmatismo para resolução de problemas;
  • Perfil protagonista, questionador, analítico e que use conhecimentos sistêmico para fazer análises profundas de problemas a serem resolvidos;
  • Capacidade de discutir trade-offs de frontend (performance, consistência de UI, dívida de componentização) e de comunicar com design e produto.
  • Prática no uso de assistentes de IA no fluxo de desenvolvimento (ex: GitHub Copilot, Cursor ou similares);
  • Boa comunicação e alinhamento com o negócio:Capacidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos de forma clara para diferentes públicos, entender os objetivos de negócio e colaborar com outros times de engenharia que usam a plataforma.

﻿

Diferenciais

  • Vivência na integração de APIs de LLMs, motores de GenAI ou plataformas de agentes;
  • Vivência no desenvolvimento e implantação de soluções utilizando Large Language Models (LLMs) em ambientes produtivos.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend Python (Django ou equivalente), autonomia para evoluir o BFF junto com o front.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios que cuidam e se diferenciam:

No Grupo Boticário, o cuidado é a nossa base para atingirmos resultados exponenciais. Temos um portfólio com mais de 20 benefícios para cuidar da sua saúde, bem estar e família. Confira abaixo.

Job Description: Leads the human resources function for assigned business units and provides comprehensive Human Resources Business Partner support to business unit leadership. Provides a broad range of human resources services to the assigned leadership team, proactively translating business needs into HR solutions that best meet business objectives. Proactively addresses human capital needs, develops strategic talent and workforce plans, and advises on organizational development needs. Leads a staff of HR professionals responsible for the business unit’s HR operations and functions.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $160,000 - 175,000 annually plus 20% AIP eligibility. The actual compensation offered may vary based on job related factors such as experience, skills, education and location. The ideal candidate will reside in the east coast of the US.

ShapetheFutureatOwens & Minor

As Owens & Minor enters a new chapter marked by new ownership, an energized executive leadership team, and a clear vision for growth and transformation, we are building the capabilities, culture, and operating discipline that will position us for long-term success.

As Director, HR Strategy &Enablement, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of our HR organization and influence meaningful business outcomes. Partnering closely with the CHRO, HR Leadership Team, and business leaders, you will play a critical role in driving strategic priorities, strengthening organizational effectiveness, and advancing a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

We are creating an environment where talented people can do their best work, make their mark, and have a meaningful impact. Our culture is grounded in mutual respect, authentic relationships, and a shared commitment to helping one another succeed. Together, we are united by a genuine desire to elevate our performance, realize our potential, and achieve great things for our customers, our colleagues, and our business.

If you are energized by transformation and inspired by the opportunity to build, improve, and lead,you willfind an organization where your contributions matter, your voice is valued, and your work will help bring our purpose to life: Life Takes Care®.

Core Responsibilities:

Strategic Program Leadership &InitiativeDelivery

  • Lead the planning, coordination, execution, and monitoring of HR strategic initiatives aligned to annual and multi-year business objectives.

  • Establish project management standards, methodologies, governance structures, and reporting processes that drive consistency and accountability across HR.

  • Provide oversight of a portfolio of strategic HR initiatives, ensuring appropriate prioritization, sequencing, resource allocation, and risk management.

  • Drive successful execution of complex, cross-functional projects through disciplined project management practices.

  • Monitor progress against milestones, deliverables, budgets, and success metrics while proactively identifying dependencies, barriers, and risks.

  • Facilitate issue resolution and decision-making to maintain momentum and ensure achievement of intended outcomes.

  • Develop and deliver executive and Board-ready presentations, strategic updates, dashboards, and communications that synthesize complex business, workforce, and operational information into compelling insights, recommendations, and narratives that drive decision-making, alignment, and action.

  • Partner with the HR Leadership Team to proactively assess impacts and develop integrated change management strategies that strengthen organizational alignment, drive adoption, and enable successful delivery of strategic priorities.

  • Promote project management excellence and strengthen project leadership capabilities across the HR organization.

  • Ensure strategic initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.

Our client is a Singapore-based fintech group with regional hubs in Lithuania and Dubai, and operations in Thailand, Indonesia, and the Philippines. Their operation is fully legal and compliant, with licenses in multiple countries and jurisdictions globally. Via their flagship product, they offer a cross-border payment solution infrastructure for money transfer operators, local banks, and corporates. With their mobile application, their retail customers and SMEs across Southeast Asia can send money to their families, friends, and business partners around the world.

﻿

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced and results-oriented Senior Director of Sales to lead our client’s global sales strategy within the Money Transfer Operator (MTO) and Payment Service Provider (PSP) sectors. This critical leadership role will be responsible for driving significant revenue growth, managing their global sales team, and expanding their footprint into key international markets. The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of the MTO/PSP landscape, a proven track record of exceeding sales targets, and an extensive network within major banks, MTOs, and payment service providers.

Job Type: Full Time

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive sales leadership experience, with a significant focus on the Money Transfer Operator (MTO) and/or Payment Service Provider (PSP) sectors.
  • Demonstrated experience with major banks, MTOs (e.g., Western Union, MoneyGram, Ria), and prominent payment service providers is essential.
  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding sales quotas and driving substantial revenue growth in complex, global environments.
  • Extensive and verifiable network of relationships with key decision-makers and influencers within the MTO and PSP industries.
  • Deep understanding of the global payments landscape, including regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and technological trends (e.g., real-time payments, blockchain, open banking).
  • Exceptional leadership and team management skills, with the ability to inspire, motivate, and develop a high-performing sales force across diverse geographies.
  • Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent negotiation, communication (written and verbal), and presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel internationally as required.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field; MBA preferred.
  • Strongly Preferred: Have client list ready to integrate

Responsibilities

  • Strategic Sales Leadership: Develop, implement, and refine comprehensive global sales strategies for the MTO and PSP segments to achieve ambitious revenue targets and market share growth.
  • Revenue Management: Own the global MTO/PSP revenue pipeline, forecasting, and P&L. Implement effective pricing strategies and negotiate high-value contracts to maximize profitability.
  • Global Market Expansion: Identify and prioritize new market opportunities within the MTO and PSP ecosystems. Develop and execute go-to-market strategies for international expansion.
  • Team Leadership & Development: Recruit, mentor, and lead a high-performing global sales team. Foster a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. Provide ongoing coaching, performance management, and career development opportunities.
  • Client Relationship Management: Cultivate and maintain strong, strategic relationships with key decision-makers within major banks, MTOs, and PSPs globally. Act as a trusted advisor and thought leader in the industry.
  • Partnership Development: Identify, evaluate, and forge strategic partnerships that accelerate market penetration and enhance our product/service offerings.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay abreast of industry trends, competitive landscape, regulatory changes, and technological advancements within the MTO and PSP space to inform sales strategies and product development.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, marketing, operations, and legal teams to ensure alignment of sales strategies with overall business objectives and to effectively bring new solutions to market.
  • Reporting & Analysis: Provide regular, insightful reports on sales performance, market trends, and pipeline status to senior leadership. Utilize data to drive informed decision-making.

About Aretum

DHS Suitability Required

Aretum is a mission-driven organization committed to delivering innovative, technology-enabled solutions to our customers across defense, civilian, and homeland security sectors. Our teams work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and transformation, helping agencies solve their most critical challenges. We believe in investing in our people and creating a culture where collaboration, inclusion, and professional growth are at the forefront.

Job Summary

Aretum is seeking a Junior Accountant to support daily accounting operations by preparing journal entries, performing account reconciliations, and assisting with financial reporting to ensure accuracy and compliance with federal accounting requirements. The role requires someone who is detail-oriented, analytical, and collaborative, with the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies while supporting month-end close activities and maintaining accurate financial records.

Due to the nature of our work as a federal consulting organization, employees may be expected to handle Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and must adhere to applicable safeguarding and compliance requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Apply Federal Accounting Standards Advisory Board (FASAB) standards and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) to analyze, reconcile, and report intergovernmental transactions.
  • Prepare financial schedules supporting elimination entries and resolve trading partner discrepancies.
  • Prepare and post U.S. Standard General Ledger (USSGL)-compliant journal entries to ensure accurate financial reporting.
  • Review payroll accounting transactions prior to posting to verify accuracy and compliance.
  • Prepare payroll accruals and reconcile payroll disbursements from multiple payroll sources to U.S. Treasury disbursements.
  • Identify, research, and resolve payroll accounting discrepancies, preparing corrective journal entries as needed.
  • Reconcile Fund Balance with Treasury (FBWT) to agency financial reporting and investigate variances.
  • Document reconciliation findings, recommend corrective actions, and prepare USSGL-compliant journal entries to resolve identified discrepancies.
  • Ensure all reconciliations, journal entries, and supporting documentation comply with federal accounting standards, agency policies, and reporting requirements.

Requirements

  • BS and 2 (+) years' experience or equivalent education and experience.
  • Experienced accounting professional with strong analytical, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams.
  • Proven team player with experience working in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.
  • Experience supporting federal accounting operations, including general ledger activities and monthly financial close processes.
  • Experience preparing and analyzing financial statements.
  • Ability to interpret and apply U.S. Treasury USSGL accounting scenarios or comparable private-sector accounting standards.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Experience developing, documenting, and communicating financial management policies, procedures, and operational guidance.
  • Ability to implement and support changes to financial management practices and financial system operations.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to analyze complex financial data and recommend effective solutions.

Preferred

Travel Requirements

This is a remote position; however, occasional travel may be required based on project needs, client meetings, team collaboration events, or training sessions. Travel is expected to be less than 5% and will be communicated in advance whenever possible.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Aretum complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws.

We are proud to support our nation’s veterans and military families, providing career opportunities that honor their service and experience.

If you require reasonable accommodation during the hiring process due to a disability, please contact for assistance.

Due to federal contract requirements, only U.S. citizens are eligible for this position. This position supports a federal government contract and requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust or Suitability Determination, depending on the agency’s background investigation requirements.

We have a fantastic opportunity for a Group Head of Learning & Development, Communications and Partnership Engagement to join our Senior Leadership Team. This role will be remote with national travel.

Reporting directly to the Group Chief People Officer you will be responsible for leading on EMED Group’s strategy for learning and organisational development, internal and external communications, partnership engagement and social values, ensuring these areas are aligned to operational and strategic priorities to support the capability, leadership culture and social impact needed to deliver exceptional patient care, operational excellence and sustainable growth.

Benefits for the role include

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual car allowance
  • Performance related bonus
  • Private Healthcare
  • 33 days annual leave (inclusive of bank holidays) with the option to purchase additional leave through salary sacrifice.
  • Life Assurance
  • 24/7 online/telephone GP Consultation and access to prescriptions.
  • 2nd opinion medical support following diagnosis or where a colleague is on a treatment pathway.
  • Cash-plan benefits, providing colleagues the option of protecting themselves in case of illness and recuperation, including dental, optical, chiropody.
  • Access to mental health and physiotherapy consultations.
  • Access to legal advice on domestic issues e.g. motoring offences, wills and probate, and personal injury.
  • Long Service Recognition Scheme – recognising colleagues for their continued service after 5 years and at 5-year intervals with an increase in annual leave.

Role Responsibilities

  • Develop, lead and implement the Group Learning & Development Strategy, aligned to EMED’s People Strategy, organisational objectives and future capability requirements.
  • Partner with the Chief People Officer, Executive Leadership Team, senior leaders and operational leaders to identify capability gaps and design learning solutions that support business priorities.
  • Design and oversee leadership and management development programmes for Managers, including the Manager Acceleration Programme and associated pathways.
  • Lead succession planning and talent development activity in partnership with HR Business Partners and senior leaders, ensuring learning supports future leadership pipelines.
  • Work collaboratively with the Training team, clinical, quality, governance, safeguarding, information governance, health and safety and operational colleagues to ensure learning responsibilities are clearly defined and support safe, compliant and high-quality patient care.
  • Maximise effective use of the Apprenticeship Levy and develop apprenticeship pathways that support frontline colleagues, managers and senior leaders.
  • Promote professional qualifications and structured development routes that enhance capability, retention and career progression.
  • Lead the development and effective delivery of internal communications channels that connect colleagues with corporate news, organisational priorities, celebrations, successes and key messages across EMED Group.
  • Work with senior leaders, operational teams and enabling functions to ensure internal communications support engagement, change, culture, colleague voice and shared organisational identity.
  • Provide leadership for internal social value activity delivered through the EMED Foundation, ensuring activity is aligned to EMED’s organisational values, community impact objectives and wider people strategy.
  • Support the leadership of EMED Foundation activity via the Trustees to deliver campaigns, colleague involvement and associated governance to ensure social value initiatives are visible, meaningful and connected to local and national priorities.
  • Work in conjunction with the Talent Resourcing team to identify and develop social value, employability, outreach and partnership activity that supports attraction, resourcing, community engagement and inclusive workforce development.
  • Build effective internal and external partnerships that support the delivery of social value commitments, including charitable relationships, community stakeholders, education partners and resourcing-related initiatives.
  • Develop opportunities to embed lived experience within colleague learning and induction, including investment in a patient-focused video that helps colleagues understand the experience of being a dialysis patient. This should include scoping an outline budget for partners to work within and ensuring the content supports empathy, awareness and patient-centred practice.
  • Work with charitable and social value partners to strengthen EMED’s external value proposition, including exploring how partner insight and content can support social value development within bids, particularly where increased weighting may be expected in future commissioning and procurement processes.
  • Planning, prioritisation, budget awareness and strategic leadership of the Learning & Development function, with potential future responsibility for team leadership as the function evolves.

Do you have what it takes?

  • Communication with Impact – articulates strategy to influence stakeholders, communicates decisively during uncertainty, inspires confidence and ensures ownership and clarity when delivering messages across teams, stakeholders, external partners and the wider business.
  • Agile Thinking – adjusts long-term plans and organisational strategies in response to changing needs, promotes collaboration across teams and proactively manages risks through experimentation, learning and innovation.
  • Delivering Results – aligns team efforts with organisational objectives, establishes clear metrics, integrates financial understanding into decision making and adapts strategies using insight to deliver commercial and operational impact.
  • Encouraging Ownership and Teamwork – empowers team members by assigning responsibility based on strengths, breaks down silos, promotes shared accountability and actively mentors others to strengthen capability.
  • Customer Focussed – ensures the organisation understands and responds to evolving customer, patient and service user needs, integrating their perspectives into strategic decision making and cross-functional delivery.
  • Delivering Clarity of Vision – develops and communicates a compelling vision for learning and organisational capability, aligning it with EMED’s strategic priorities, future workforce needs and long-term objectives.
  • Investing in Talent – actively leads succession planning, develops talent pipelines, establishes mentoring and sponsorship approaches and invests in leadership development to strengthen organisational capability.
  • Leading with Influence – engages and influences key stakeholders at a strategic level, builds credibility as a thought leader, and leads learning, engagement, social value and change initiatives that secure support for transformation and long-term success.
  • Leading Change – communicates the case for change, builds confidence through uncertainty, addresses resistance constructively and fosters a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and learning.

About Us

EMED Group is an established healthcare logistics provider that enables access to health and social care through our four specialist divisions. We are one of the largest health and care partners to the NHS with 4,000 colleagues across over 60 bases UK-wide.

EMED Group is committed to pro-actively improving the wellbeing of our communities by providing access to vital health and social care services across the UK.

EMED Group are committed to providing services for our patients, service users, clients, and community and is supported by employees with an increasing variety of backgrounds. To do this effectively it is essential that we promote equality and embrace diversity and inclusion and treat all of our employees, patients, service users and clients with dignity and respect.

EMED Group is committed to encouraging equality, diversity and inclusion among our workforce, and eliminating unlawful discrimination, with our aim being to be truly representative of all sections of society and our clients, and for each employee to feel respected, valued and able to give their best.

EMED Group are committed to providing equal opportunities and we endeavour to provide an inclusive and safe working culture for all.

Salary: Competitive Salary

O Grupo Boticário é líder de Beleza no Brasil. Unimos tecnologia, varejo, logística e soluções digitais (com A Mooz) para transformar dados em desejo e conectar toda a nossa cadeia de valor.
