Acreditamos que a beleza pode e deve inspirar mudanças.

Construa o futuro da beleza com a gente. Vamos juntos?

O que é o nosso time de Venda Direta?

No time de Venda Direta temos a missão de trazer beleza para a vida das nossas representantes. Entendemos a venda direta também como forma de empoderar quem sonha em empreender, e por isso queremos a melhor experiência possível para as pessoas empreendedoras. Em um mundo cada vez mais digital, transformar esse canal pela tecnologia é como construímos um ecossistema de beleza.

O produto em que você vai atuar:

No Grupo Boticário, Inteligência Artificial Generativa é pilar estratégico. Você irá atuar no time de Plataforma de Agentes: plataforma centralizada para criar, gerir e executar agentes LLM nos canais de negócio do GB. Sua missão será criar uma plataforma de construção de agentes para dar autonomia ao uso de Gen AI em times funcionais. Nosso foco é garantir que chegue até os diversos clientes do Grupo Boticário as melhores soluções envolvendo IA, alavancando resultados tangíveis para a empresa.

Como será o seu dia

  • Em parceria com o Tech Lead, você ajudará a materializar a visão técnica dos produtos, garantindo a escrita de código limpo, algoritmos otimizados e participando ativamente de revisões técnicas para manter o baixo débito técnico da squad.
  • Implementar e evoluir a interface da Plataforma de Agentes com produto e design.
  • Sua missão envolve executar com excelência garantindo a qualidade do produto: testes, acessibilidade, tagueamento/analytics da jornada, observabilidade no front, testes.
  • Implementar as melhores soluções de frontend e backend para nossos usuários, visando sempre a qualidade, performance, melhores práticas de programação, simplicidade e melhor experiência de uso;
  • Desenvolver, realizar testes unitários, implantar e monitorar o que foi desenvolvido, além de garantir a qualidade e boas práticas de programação;
  • Aprimorar aplicações identificando oportunidades de melhoria, fazer recomendações, projetar e implementar sistemas;
  • Participar ativamente das decisões na implementação dos produtos, demonstrando sentimento de dono;
  • Manter, melhorar e revisar códigos existentes através de Code Review e Pair Programming;
  • Manter bom relacionamento buscando soluções inovadoras para os projetos;
  • Manter documentação atualizada;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa, usando de boa comunicação;
  • Se apaixonar pela resolução de problemas e busca de soluções viáveis.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento web utilizando React
  • Sólida experiência com testes automatizados (Unitário, integração, E2E);
  • Experiência com Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD), GitHub, GitHub Actions e Sonar.
  • Conhecimento da plataforma AWS.
  • Familiaridade com desenvolvimento seguro (avaliações de segurança, vulnerabilidades, atuação em incidentes, etc);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis como Scrum e Kanban;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente multifuncional, multi-linguagem e colaborativo, de maneira autónoma;
  • Pragmatismo para resolução de problemas;
  • Perfil protagonista, questionador, analítico e que use conhecimentos sistêmico para fazer análises profundas de problemas a serem resolvidos;
  • Capacidade de discutir trade-offs de frontend (performance, consistência de UI, dívida de componentização) e de comunicar com design e produto.
  • Prática no uso de assistentes de IA no fluxo de desenvolvimento (ex: GitHub Copilot, Cursor ou similares);
  • Boa comunicação e alinhamento com o negócio:Capacidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos de forma clara para diferentes públicos, entender os objetivos de negócio e colaborar com outros times de engenharia que usam a plataforma.

raw.description:
Owens & Minor is a global healthcare solutions company providing essential products, services and technology solutions that support care delivery in leading hospitals, health systems and research centers around the world. For over 140 years, Owens & Minor has delivered comfort and confidence behind the scenes, so healthcare stays at the forefront, helping to make each day better for the hospitals, healthcare partners, and communities we serve. Powered by more than 14,000 teammates worldwide, Owens & Minor exists because every day, everywhere, Life Takes Care™.

Global Reach with a Local Touch

  • 140+ years serving healthcare

  • Over 14,000 teammates worldwide

  • Serving healthcare partners in 80 countries

  • Manufacturing facilities in the U.S., Honduras, Mexico, Thailand and Ireland

  • 40+ distribution centers

  • Portfolio of 300 propriety and branded product offerings

  • 1,000 branded medical product suppliers

  • 4,000 healthcare partners served

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Healthcare Plan - Medical, dental, and vision plans start on day one of employment for full-time teammates.

  • Educational Assistance - We offer educational assistance to all eligible teammates enrolled in an approved, accredited collegiate program.

  • Employer-Paid Life Insurance and Disability - We offer employer-paid life insurance and disability coverage.

  • Voluntary Supplemental Programs – We offer additional options to secure your financial future including supplemental life, hospitalization, critical illness, and other insurance programs.

  • Support for your Growing Family – Adoption assistance, fertility benefits (in medical plan) and parental leave are available for teammates planning for a family.

  • Health Savings Account (HSA) and 401(k) - We offer these voluntary financial programs to help teammates prepare for their future, as well as other voluntary benefits.

  • Paid Leave - In addition to sick days and short-term leave, we offer holidays, vacation days, personal days, and additional types of leave – including parental leave.

  • Well-Being – Also included in our offering is a Teammate Assistance Program (TAP), Calm Health, Cancer Resources Services, and discount programs – all at no cost to you.

Job Description: Leads the human resources function for assigned business units and provides comprehensive Human Resources Business Partner support to business unit leadership. Provides a broad range of human resources services to the assigned leadership team, proactively translating business needs into HR solutions that best meet business objectives. Proactively addresses human capital needs, develops strategic talent and workforce plans, and advises on organizational development needs. Leads a staff of HR professionals responsible for the business unit’s HR operations and functions.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $160,000 - 175,000 annually plus 20% AIP eligibility. The actual compensation offered may vary based on job related factors such as experience, skills, education and location. The ideal candidate will reside in the east coast of the US.

ShapetheFutureatOwens & Minor

As Owens & Minor enters a new chapter marked by new ownership, an energized executive leadership team, and a clear vision for growth and transformation, we are building the capabilities, culture, and operating discipline that will position us for long-term success.

As Director, HR Strategy &Enablement, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of our HR organization and influence meaningful business outcomes. Partnering closely with the CHRO, HR Leadership Team, and business leaders, you will play a critical role in driving strategic priorities, strengthening organizational effectiveness, and advancing a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

We are creating an environment where talented people can do their best work, make their mark, and have a meaningful impact. Our culture is grounded in mutual respect, authentic relationships, and a shared commitment to helping one another succeed. Together, we are united by a genuine desire to elevate our performance, realize our potential, and achieve great things for our customers, our colleagues, and our business.

If you are energized by transformation and inspired by the opportunity to build, improve, and lead,you willfind an organization where your contributions matter, your voice is valued, and your work will help bring our purpose to life: Life Takes Care®.

Core Responsibilities:

Strategic Program Leadership &InitiativeDelivery

  • Lead the planning, coordination, execution, and monitoring of HR strategic initiatives aligned to annual and multi-year business objectives.

  • Establish project management standards, methodologies, governance structures, and reporting processes that drive consistency and accountability across HR.

  • Provide oversight of a portfolio of strategic HR initiatives, ensuring appropriate prioritization, sequencing, resource allocation, and risk management.

  • Drive successful execution of complex, cross-functional projects through disciplined project management practices.

  • Monitor progress against milestones, deliverables, budgets, and success metrics while proactively identifying dependencies, barriers, and risks.

  • Facilitate issue resolution and decision-making to maintain momentum and ensure achievement of intended outcomes.

  • Develop and deliver executive and Board-ready presentations, strategic updates, dashboards, and communications that synthesize complex business, workforce, and operational information into compelling insights, recommendations, and narratives that drive decision-making, alignment, and action.

  • Partner with the HR Leadership Team to proactively assess impacts and develop integrated change management strategies that strengthen organizational alignment, drive adoption, and enable successful delivery of strategic priorities.

  • Promote project management excellence and strengthen project leadership capabilities across the HR organization.

  • Ensure strategic initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.

Financial Stewardship & Resource Management

  • Support the planning, allocation, and management of budgets and resources associated with HR strategic initiatives, ensuring effective investment decisions, and alignment with organizational priorities while identifying opportunities to optimize costs and maximize value.

  • Monitor expenditures associated with strategic programs and initiatives to ensure effective utilization of resources.

  • Provide visibility into initiative-related costs, resource allocation, and budget performance.

  • Support business cases and investment recommendations related to key HR programs, technology, and transformation initiatives.

Cross-Functional Partnership, Integration & Relationship Management

  • Serve as a highly collaborative partner across HR and the broader organization to ensure alignment around strategic priorities and shared objectives.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior leaders, business partners, Centers of Excellence, and functional stakeholders.

  • Act as an integrator, bringing together perspectives, teams, and initiatives to drive organizational alignment and collective success.

  • Foster transparency and communication across stakeholders to ensure awareness, coordination, and effective decision- making.

  • Facilitate collaboration across multiple functions to manage interdependencies and support execution of enterprise-wide priorities.

  • Create forums, mechanisms, and processes that promote connectedness and information sharing across HR and partner functions.

  • Develop a reputation as a trusted advisor and relationship builder capable of bringing teams together to solve complex organizational challenges.

HREnablement& Continuous Improvement

  • Champion a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement throughout the HR function.

  • Lead efforts to evaluate and enhance the effectiveness, efficiency, and sustainability of HR processes, programs, and operating practices.

  • Identify opportunities to improve service delivery, simplify workflows, enhance collaboration, and reduce complexity.

  • Synthesize data, insights, and strategic recommendations into executive-ready materials that effectively communicate business impact, progress against goals, and future opportunities.

  • Leverage metrics, stakeholder feedback, lessons learned, and performance data to drive ongoing improvement.

  • Introduce best practices that strengthen organizational effectiveness, project execution, and operational performance.

  • Partner across HR to identify scalable solutions that elevate productivity, quality, employee experience, and business impact.

Qualifying Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Education, Psychology, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred.

  • Eight or more years of progressive experience in HR, Strategy & Operations, Program Management, Organizational Effectiveness, Business Operations, or related disciplines.

  • Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional strategic initiatives from planning through implementation, delivering measurable business outcomes on time and within budget.

  • Proven experience establishing project management disciplines, governance processes, and operational frameworks that enhance execution, accountability, and organizational effectiveness.

  • Experience managing budgets, resources, and financial oversight for strategic programs and initiatives.

  • Strong ability to build trusted relationships, influence senior leaders, and facilitate collaboration across matrixed organizations to achieve shared objectives.

  • Proven track record of leading continuous improvement, organizational effectiveness, and change management efforts that drive operational excellence and business performance.

  • Experience partnering directly with executive leadership teams and supporting enterprise-level decision-making.

​

  • Strong proficiency in Smartsheet with demonstrated mastery of advanced formulas, workflow automations, relational data tools, and executive dashboards

  • Exceptional executive communication, presentation development, and storytelling skills, including the ability to create and deliver executive- and Board-ready materials that translate complex information into compelling insights, recommendations, and actions.

  • Strategic Leadership: Aligns priorities, anticipates future needs, and translates strategy into actionable plans that drive organizational and business results.

  • Program & Operational Excellence: Leads complex initiatives through disciplined project management, governance, financial stewardship, and successful delivery of outcomes.

  • Collaboration & Influence: Builds strong relationships, fosters alignment, and effectively partners across diverse stakeholder groups to achieve shared goals.

  • Communication & Executive Presence: Communicates with clarity, confidence, and influence through executive storytelling, presentations, and facilitation of strategic discussions.

  • Continuous Improvement & Change Leadership: Champions innovation, organizational effectiveness, and sustainable change that enhances performance, productivity, and business impact.

  • Ability to travel as needed.

If you feel this opportunity could be the next step in your career, we encourage you to apply. This position will accept applications on an ongoing basis.

Owens & Minor is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, genetic information, religion, disability, age, status as a veteran, or any other status prohibited by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

raw.description:
Customer Service Representative / Dispatcher (Home Services) – Remote

Customer Service | Dispatch Coordination | ServiceTitan | Home Services

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Customer Service Representative / Dispatcher to serve as the primary point of contact for customers while coordinating technician schedules and dispatch operations for a growing home services business.

This is a fast-paced, customer-facing role where you’ll manage inbound inquiries, schedule service appointments, coordinate field technicians, and ensure customers receive timely updates throughout the service process. You’ll play a vital role in keeping daily operations running efficiently while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

The ideal candidate has previous experience supporting HVAC, plumbing, electrical, or other home service companies, thrives under pressure, and is highly organized with excellent communication skills.

What You’ll Own

Customer Service & Client Communication

  • Answer inbound customer calls, emails, and service inquiries professionally.
  • Assist customers with appointment scheduling, service updates, and general inquiries.
  • Resolve customer concerns with empathy while escalating complex issues when appropriate.
  • Respond to customer messages across multiple communication channels, including social media.
  • Deliver a positive customer experience throughout every interaction.

Scheduling & Dispatch Coordination

  • Schedule service appointments accurately using ServiceTitan.
  • Coordinate technician schedules and dispatch field technicians efficiently.
  • Manage appointment changes, cancellations, and emergency service requests.
  • Ensure technicians receive complete and accurate job information before dispatch.
  • Optimize technician schedules to maximize efficiency and service quality.

Service Operations Support

  • Review incoming service requests and ensure all jobs are properly scheduled.
  • Monitor active work orders and open service tickets.
  • Maintain accurate customer records, notes, and follow-up tasks.
  • Ensure no customer requests or appointments fall through the cracks.
  • Support daily operational workflows to improve service delivery.

Administrative & Reporting Support

  • Maintain accurate documentation within ServiceTitan and internal systems.
  • Update customer records, dispatch notes, and operational logs.
  • Assist with reporting, tracking, and operational follow-up activities.
  • Support internal teams with administrative tasks related to dispatch and customer service.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • Previous experience in Customer Service and Dispatch roles.
  • Experience supporting HVAC, Plumbing, Electrical, Home Services, or Trade Services companies.
  • Experience handling high-volume inbound customer calls.
  • Strong understanding of scheduling and dispatch operations.
  • Experience coordinating emergency or urgent service requests.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with ServiceTitan.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience supporting U.S.-based home service companies.
  • Experience handling customer communication through social media platforms.
  • Additional customer service or dispatch certifications.
  • Experience using other CRM or field service management platforms.

Tools & Platforms

  • ServiceTitan
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Google Sheets
  • CRM & Service Management Platforms
  • Microsoft Office
  • Google Workspace

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly organized with excellent multitasking abilities.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Calm, solution-oriented, and composed during busy periods.
  • Takes ownership of issues and follows through until resolution.
  • Thrives in fast-paced, customer-focused environments.
  • Comfortable coordinating both customers and field technicians simultaneously.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review incoming service requests and technician schedules.
  • Answer customer inquiries and schedule appointments.
  • Dispatch technicians to service calls.
  • Coordinate schedule adjustments and emergency requests.
  • Update customer records and service notes.
  • Communicate with technicians throughout the day.
  • Monitor open work orders and ensure timely completion.
  • Support daily operational reporting and administrative tasks.

In short: You ensure customers receive timely, professional service while keeping technician schedules organized and dispatch operations running smoothly.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Appointment scheduling accuracy
  • Technician utilization and schedule efficiency
  • Customer satisfaction and response times
  • Call handling efficiency
  • Dispatch accuracy
  • Timely follow-up and task completion
  • Accuracy of ServiceTitan documentation and operational records

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Fully remote opportunity with a growing home services organization.
  • High-impact role supporting daily field operations.
  • Fast-paced environment with strong ownership and responsibility.
  • Opportunity to develop expertise in dispatch operations and customer service.
  • Career growth into Operations, Dispatch Management, or Customer Success leadership roles.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Customer Service Representative and Dispatcher who enjoys helping customers, coordinating field operations, and keeping fast-paced service teams running efficiently, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a key part of a growing home services team.

raw.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

The Motorola Solutions Channel and Services Team empowers our customers to identify and unleash the full power of their PCR products and services. We build strong relationships with our Channel Partners to promote their full adoption of Motorola products and services, including growing their ongoing use, value realization and product satisfaction. We work to ensure that the customer experience with Motorola Solutions continuously exceeds their expectations and through our internal and external relationships, we are committed to consistent delivery and follow through to help Partners and Sales serve their communities and to be their best in the moments that matter.


Job Description

The Channel Engagement Manager (CEM) serves as a critical link between the company and its channel partners in the Western Territory, managing and supporting their needs across sales, technical, and operational aspects. This role involves active participation in strategic projects, issue resolution, and ensuring partner success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for channel partners and dealers, managing relationships to support their business needs.

  • Initiate and coordinate internal resources, including Technical Support and Engineering, to resolve partner and customer issues and support open cases.

Sales and Project Facilitation:

  • Collaborate with dealers on pre-sales activities, such as drafting and finalizing Statements of Work (SOW) and design plans for end customers.

  • Facilitate the quoting processes with COEE if needed, including discussing subscriber type and quantity with channel partners for project upgrades.

  • Work with partners and end customers on project execution, including discussing technical requirements by facilitating engineering design discussions.

  • Keep the Sales team apprised of activity related to issues outside their awareness.

Account and System Issue Resolution:

  • Actively follow up and work with internal teams (e.g., Customer Master Data Team, IT, Subscription Mgmt., WAVE Support,) to address partner and end-user issues related to accounts, product licensing (e.g., WAVE devices), payment terms (e.g., NET 30), and inconsistencies across internal systems (OM, CDM, Greenfield, Partner Hub)

​On-site Project Coordination and Compliance:

  • Coordinate on-site activities and logistics for major post sale support projects, including communicating with customer site leadership and internal teams.

  • Ensure third-party vendors (e.g., tower crews) meet customer site-specific safety training requirements.

  • Develop and communicate project plans, responsibility matrices, and communication plans with partners and customers.

  • Keep relevant internal teams and management informed of project status and critical issues.

Target Base Salary Range: $100,000 - $110,000 USD

Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.

Accepting applications between September 2026 and November 2026.


Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree with 5+ years of experience in one of the following: Project Management, Field Engineering, customer service, customer support

  • OR 7+ years of experience in one of the following: Project Management, Field Engineering, customer service, customer support


Travel Requirements

25-50%


Relocation Provided

None


Position Type

Experienced


Referral Payment Plan

Yes

Our U.S. Benefits include:

  • Incentive Bonus Plans

  • Medical, Dental, Vision benefits

  • 401K with Company Match

  • 10 Paid Holidays

  • Generous Paid Time Off Packages

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • Paid Parental & Family Leave

  • and more!

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience for candidates with disabilities, or other physical or mental health conditions. To request an accommodation, please complete this Reasonable Accommodations Form so we can assist you.

Loan Coordinator (Mortgage Operations & Lender Liaison) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Loan Coordinator / Lender Liaison to ensure loan files move efficiently from submission through closing.

This role serves as the primary bridge between internal teams and lending partners, keeping loan files organized, coordinating documentation, tracking progress, and ensuring every deadline is met. If you’re experienced in mortgage operations and thrive in a fast-paced, detail-oriented environment, this role is a great fit.

What You’ll Do

Lender Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact with lending partners.
  • Maintain regular communication throughout the loan lifecycle.
  • Follow up on outstanding lender requests and documentation.
  • Escalate issues proactively to prevent funding or closing delays.

Loan Pipeline Management

  • Monitor active loan files from submission through closing.
  • Maintain accurate loan status updates and progress tracking.
  • Review loan reports and identify delays or missing documentation.
  • Keep stakeholders informed of loan progress and next steps.

Internal Coordination

  • Work with internal teams to gather required documentation.
  • Coordinate responses to underwriting conditions and lender requests.
  • Support timely submission of loan packages.
  • Ensure deadlines and timelines remain on track.

Documentation & File Management

  • Organize and maintain complete loan files.
  • Record correspondence and supporting documentation.
  • Maintain accurate CRM and loan management system records.
  • Verify file completeness before key milestones and closing.

Process Improvement

  • Identify workflow inefficiencies.
  • Recommend improvements to loan coordination processes.
  • Support standardized procedures for lender communication and pipeline management.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience in loan coordination, loan processing, mortgage operations, lender relations, or a similar role.
  • Strong understanding of the mortgage and lending process.
  • Experience managing loan files from submission through closing.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and project management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple active loan files simultaneously.
  • Experience using CRM systems and Google Workspace.
  • High attention to detail and deadline management skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Reliable internet connection and availability for 30+ hours per week.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with DSCR, investment-property, or non-QM loans.
  • Experience supporting real estate investors.
  • Familiarity with Encompass, LendingPad, Jungo, Salesforce, or similar loan platforms.
  • Background in real estate operations or acquisitions.
  • Experience supporting U.S.-based mortgage lenders or brokers.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review active loan files and lender updates.
  • Follow up on outstanding conditions and documentation.
  • Coordinate with lenders, underwriters, and internal teams.
  • Update loan statuses and CRM records.
  • Track deadlines and resolve bottlenecks.
  • Ensure loan files are complete before closing.

In short: You’ll keep loan files organized, lenders informed, and closings on schedule from submission through funding.

What Success Looks Like

  • Loan files progress smoothly through the pipeline.
  • Deadlines and closing timelines are consistently met.
  • Accurate and organized loan documentation.
  • Strong communication with lenders and internal teams.
  • Reduced processing delays and bottlenecks.
  • High stakeholder satisfaction.

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Client Interview
  4. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your mortgage operations experience, and highlight your background in loan coordination, lender communication, documentation management, and pipeline tracking. Your video will be reviewed before moving forward in the interview process.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you enjoy keeping loan files organized, coordinating with lenders, managing deadlines, and ensuring smooth loan closings, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help deliver an exceptional lending experience.

raw.description:
ACU is affiliated with the fellowship of the Church of Christ. All qualified applicants for this position must be professing Christians and willing to support the Christian mission and purpose of the university. Churches of Christ membership is preferred for this position.

‌

Faculty Rank: College Assistant Professor, College Associate Professor, or College Professor (all non-tenured)
Position Location: Remote, with the possibility of limited travel

The key principles of this job are to:

  • Support ACU’s Mission: Educate students for Christian service and leadership throughout the world.

  • Support ACU’s Vision: Become a premier university for the education of Christ-centered leaders.

Scope:

  • The Program Director manages all areas related to the day-to-day operations of the B.S. in Education Studies and Learning Development program. The Program Director reports to the Dean of the College of Learning and Development.

  • The Program Director also oversees coordination related to external educator preparation and certification partnership pathways associated with the program, including collaboration with university departments and external partners supporting Texas teacher certification opportunities.

Major Responsibilities

  • Lead and oversee the online B.S. in Education Studies and Learning Development program.

  • Supervise and evaluate the performance of faculty and facilitators of the program.

  • Teach in the program.

  • Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of full-time and adjunct faculty regularly.

  • Administer the academic, personnel, recruitment, and administrative life of the program.

  • Stay abreast of current trends in education, instructional practice, teacher preparation, and workforce needs, and adjust program practices as applicable.

  • Utilize data to inform practice in pedagogy, student engagement, student achievement, retention, and alignment to standards.

  • Advise undergraduate students toward the completion of their degrees.

  • Coordinate and support operational processes related to external educator preparation and teacher certification partnerships.

  • Collaborate with university departments and external partners regarding certification-related student progression, field experiences, and operational alignment.

Essential Duties

Essential duties include the following. Other duties may be assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

1. Lead and oversee the B.S. in Education Studies and Learning Development program

  • Lead the faculty in developing plans to further the purpose, mission, vision, and goals of the program.

  • Chair regular meetings of faculty, facilitators, and students for the purpose of conducting the academic and co-curricular affairs of the program.

  • Build a spirit of teamwork and collegiality among faculty, facilitators, and students.

  • Collaborate with various university departments, including Enrollment, Student Success, Registration Operations, Academic Affairs, Marketing, and external educator preparation partners, as applicable.

  • Monitor and evaluate the program annually as part of the Annual Academic Program Review.

  • Direct the annual process of evaluating and developing the program’s purpose, mission, vision, and strategic plans.

  • Work with faculty and facilitators to develop annual program performance goals.

  • Review program metrics and analyze data to address trends, strengths, challenges, and opportunities.

  • Participate in program review meetings and annual reviews with the Dean regarding program strategy, performance, and future direction.

  • Coordinate program processes associated with certification partnership pathways, including progression checkpoints, GPA requirements, and field-based experience coordination in collaboration with university teams and external partners.

2. Teach in the program

  • Administer and provide instruction in assigned courses. Duties include, but are not limited to, conducting periodic synchronous interaction sessions, facilitating and grading assignments in a timely manner, and providing rich and timely feedback on student work.

  • Provide timely and helpful responses to student inquiries regarding course material or academic matters.

Full-time Faculty Teaching Loads for Administrative Faculty (Program Directors)

  • Undergraduate: 30 credit hours (10 courses annually)

Full-time Faculty Workload Expectations

  • Undergraduate: Teaching (60%); Service (40%); Research (0%)

3. Supervise and evaluate the performance of program faculty

  • Monitor all program courses to ensure continuity of service to students.

  • Monitor all program courses to determine faculty effectiveness and adherence to university policies.

  • Recruit, onboard, hire, and terminate faculty as needed.

4. Administer the academic and administrative life of the program

  • Serve on the ACU Dallas Academic Council for participation in shared governance and representation of the program’s academic concerns.

  • Oversee the process of reviewing student applications to the program and make final decisions regarding admission.

  • Oversee the revision and development of curriculum.

  • Supervise the collection and analysis of data related to program outcomes and student learning outcomes.

  • Cooperate with ACU Marketing to develop and maintain ongoing alumni relations and recruitment efforts.

  • Prepare program publications and other correspondence as needed.

  • Facilitate regular meetings of faculty and facilitators.

  • Serve on various college and university committees as assigned by the Dean.

  • Oversee degree plans and progression pathways.

  • Coordinate with Student Success Advisors regarding monitoring and addressing student needs.

  • Support university processes associated with external teacher certification partnerships and educator preparation coordination.

  • Maintain awareness of TEA standards, certification expectations, and relevant policy updates impacting students enrolled in certification-aligned pathways.

Professional Development Requirements

In order to perform the duties of the Program Director (Administrative Faculty), it is necessary to demonstrate the following competencies:

  • Attention to detail and follow through.

  • Time management and organizational skills.

  • Maintain confidentiality.

  • Computer proficiency.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal abilities.

  • Provide quality instruction and support to students while maintaining academic and university standards.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with multiple constituencies.

  • Effective and appropriate leadership and administration of the program.

  • Develop and maintain working relationships with university administrators, faculty, staff, and external educational partners.

  • Ability to manage complex operational and academic processes related to online education and certification partnership pathways.

Qualifications

Professional

  • Ph.D. or Ed.D. or other terminal degree in Education, Teacher Education, Curriculum and Instruction, Educational Leadership, or a closely related discipline.

  • Teaching experience or administrative experience in higher education preferred.

  • At least 5 years of experience in PK–12 education, instructional leadership, educator preparation, or teacher development preferred.

  • Experience teaching, designing, and developing online coursework.

  • Experience collaborating with educator preparation programs, certification pathways, or school partnerships preferred.

  • Computer literate in software and internet-based applications.

Personal

  • Churches of Christ membership preferred

  • Strong communication skills, both written and oral.

  • Ability to view and manage role and responsibilities in relation to the larger mission, goals, and perspective of the university.

Job Description: The Skin Health Sr Product Manager will be responsible for driving and executing marketing programs that support the Skin Health category needs to build a sustainable and profitable business. Working in collaboration with the cross-functional teams, this position is accountable for leading projects and developing initiatives that help drive the key strategies and the success of the Skin Health business. The position will report to the Director, Skin Health.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $135,000 - 145,000 annually plus 15% AIP eligibility. The actual compensation offered may vary based on job related factors such as experience, skills, education and location. The ideal candidate will reside in the east coast of the US.

Core Responsibilities:

raw.description:
Futures start here. Where first steps, new friendships, and confident learners are born. At KinderCare Learning Companies, the first and only early childhood education provider recognized with theGallup Exceptional Workplace Award, we offer a variety of early education and child care options for families. Whether it’s KinderCare Learning Centers, Champions, or Crème de la Crème, we build confidence for kids, families, and the future we share. And we want you to join us in shaping it—in neighborhoods, at work, and in schools nationwide.

At KinderCare Learning Companies, you’ll use your skills and expertise to support the work (and fun) that happens in our sites and centers every day. From marketers and strategists to financial analysts and data engineers, and so much more, we’re all passionate about crafting a world where children, families, and organizations can thrive.

The Senior Manager, Strategic Talent Elevation is an enterprise talent architect and builder — a rare profile who co-owns talent strategy with the VP and then operationalizes it with precision across a $2.5B, 45,000-person organization. This is not a "run the playbook" role, nor a pure strategy seat. It is deliberately both: you help shape the philosophy, frameworks, and governance for how KLC identifies, develops, and retains talent. You also own the disciplined execution that turns those frameworks into programs that run on time across a distributed, matrixed, multi-brand environment.

This role sits within KinderCare’s newly formed Enterprise Center of Excellence, Talent Strategy & Elevation, working directly with the VP as a strategic thought partner and execution engine. The full talent portfolio runs through this role: performance management, talent reviews, succession and pipeline, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness. This is a build role — systems aren't complete, calendars aren't consistent, and standards need to be set. The right person has architected talent systems before (not just administered someone else's), knows how to move work through influence rather than authority, and genuinely wants to get into the field to learn our brands, our centers, and the people who run them.

Responsibilities:

  • Co-own the strategy — Bring a developed point of view to framework design: calibration philosophy, succession methodology, performance differentiation, and segmentation criteria; you draft, challenge, and co-author enterprise talent strategy alongside the VP — not wait for it to be handed down

  • Execute with precision — Own the operational spine: calendars, toolkits, launch governance, readiness checks, analytics, and follow-through; s you are accountable for programs running cleanly, consistently, and on time across every brand and corporate function; build a strong partnership with Talent Program Manager

  • Build through partnership — Nothing in this portfolio ships alone. L&D, HR Operations, and HRBPs are your co-builders and delivery partners — this role succeeds or fails on the strength of those relationships

TALENT STRATEGY CO-OWNERSHIP

  • Partner with the VP, Talent Strategy & Elevation to architect the enterprise talent management strategy (philosophy, governance model, and multi-year roadmap) and evolve it based on outcomes data

  • Bring a credible, developed point of view to design decisions: what good calibration looks like, why succession plans fail, and how performance differentiation connects to business outcomes

  • Represent this function in cross-functional settings and serve as an extension of the VP with HRBPs, L&D, and HR Operations partners

PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT

  • Co-design and operationalize the enterprise performance management framework — structure, rating philosophy, calibration process design, and governance

  • Build the annual calibration process and manager toolkits, partnering with HRBPs who lead field delivery and with L&D on manager capability building

  • Govern PIP and coaching standards for consistency across brands, in partnership with HRBPs and Employee Relations

  • Own performance outcomes analytics: distribution, manager compliance, and correlation to attrition, mobility, and business results

  • Maintain and enhance HRIS talent modules in partnership with HR Operations and Principal Talent Program Manager

TALENT REVIEWS & CALIBRATION

  • Architect and govern the enterprise talent review process — calibration methodology, assessment framework (6-box), readiness ratings, and talent segmentation criteria

  • Design the facilitation approach and calibration guides alongside L&D partners

  • Own hi-potential identification criteria and program design, collaborating with L&D on development programming

  • Define program efficacy metrics and run measurement and success criteria

SUCCESSION & PIPELINE

  • Build and own the succession planning methodology: successor identification criteria, readiness laddering, depth targets, and development plan integration

  • Drive documentation of critical-role succession plans with depth ratings and clear development linkage

  • Drive internal mobility strategy and governance, defining how movement happens across brands and corporate functions and moving the needle on cross-brand mobility and career velocity

  • Design career pathing frameworks for key role families and coordinate with HRBPs on field-level implementation

WORKFORCE PLANNING & ORGANIZATIONAL EFFECTIVENESS

  • Serve as the talent voice in enterprise workforce planning: connect succession depth, skills gap analysis, and readiness data to the organization's 1–3 year workforce plan

  • Co-own mission-critical role identification with HR-ELT, ensuring successor health is visible in planning conversations and pipeline risk is flagged early to TA and the business

  • Partner with HRBPs on spans-and-layers analysis and organizational effectiveness diagnostics

  • Apply OE frameworks to measure people program efficacy across the CoE portfolio — not just whether programs ran, but whether they moved outcomes

PROGRAM OPERATIONS & ENTERPRISE CALENDAR

  • Accountable for the enterprise talent calendar — performance, succession, and talent review cycles — anticipating conflicts, advocating for sequencing, and driving cross-functional readiness; Talent Program Manager responsible for driving calendar and project plans

  • Lead program launch governance in partnership with the Principal Talent Program Manager: stakeholder alignment, readiness checks, communication cadence, and post-launch retrospectives

  • Track and report program efficacy metrics (succession pipeline conversion, performance completion, talent movement) to the VP and CHRO

FIELD & BRAND ENGAGEMENT

  • Travel regularly to centers and field sites to learn brand nuances and build relationships with brand and field leaders

  • Learn our brands from the inside — how they operate, what their talent realities are, and where enterprise frameworks need to flex — and bring that field intelligence back into program design

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 3 years owning or co-owning enterprise-level talent management programs and leading a team

  • Proven experience architecting talent review, succession, and performance systems — designing frameworks from the ground up, not just running someone else's — inside a large, distributed organization (10,000+ employees strongly preferred)

  • A developed talent philosophy and the confidence to bring a point of view to strategy conversations with the VP and senior stakeholders — paired with the humility to co-create rather than dictate

  • Exceptional operational discipline: you build calendars, design toolkits, track milestones, and follow up without being asked; execution precision is a point of pride, not an afterthought

  • Skilled at facilitation, stakeholder management and executive presence, and influencing without authority in a matrixed environment; strong collaborative instincts with L&D, HR Operations, and HRBP partners

  • Strong data orientation: comfortable owning program analytics and building a compelling narrative from talent outcomes data

  • Workday Talent or equivalent HRIS experience required

  • A genuine desire to get into the field — visiting centers, learning our brands, and building relationships beyond the corporate center; comfortable with periodic travel for program delivery

  • Ability to travel up to 25%

Our benefits meet you where you are. We’re here to help our employees navigate the integration of work and life:
- Know your whole family is supported with discounted child care benefits.

- Breathe easy with medical, dental, and vision benefits for your family (and pets, too!).
- Feel supported in your mental health and personal growth with employee assistance programs.
- Feel great and thrive with access to health and wellness programs, paid time off and discounts for work necessities, such as cell phones.

- … and much more.

We operate research-backed, accredited, and customizable programs in more than 2,000 sites and centers across 40 states and the District of Columbia. As we expand, we’re matching the needs of more and more families, dynamic work environments, and diverse communities from coast to coast. Because we believe every family deserves access to high-quality child care, no matter who they are or where they live. Every day, you’ll help bring this mission to life by building community and delivering exceptional experiences. And if you’re anything like us, you’ll come for the work, and stay for the people.

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Senior Manager, Enterprise Patient Engagement Operations

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will support the coordination and execution of patient engagement activities across Amgen's enterprise and portfolio teams. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, this individual will help ensure a consistent, seamless, and patient-centered approach to engagement across the organization.

The Senior Manager will drive operational excellence and continuity across end-to-end patient engagement activities, supporting onboarding, strategic communications, storytelling initiatives, key meetings and events, and enterprise-wide collaboration. This role will help connect efforts across functions and therapeutic areas, ensuring alignment, visibility, and effective execution of patient engagement priorities. Through strong coordination, project management, and stakeholder engagement, the Senior Manager will contribute to delivering superior patient experiences and strengthening Amgen's commitment to patients across the enterprise.

This position is remote, with travel anticipated to support key meetings, events, and cross-functional collaboration, and will report to the Director of Enterprise Advocacy Operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive enterprise-wide patient engagement operational excellence across all therapeutic areas by establishing and continuously improving capabilities, tools, processes, governance frameworks, and best practices that enable consistent, scalable, and high-impact engagement with patients and patient communities.

  • Support coordination and alignment of patient engagement activities across Amgen functions, ensuring integration with therapeutic area and enterprise priorities.

  • Serve as the primary liaison to R&D Operations and key cross-functional partners to enhance patient engagement planning, governance, execution, and operational effectiveness across the enterprise.

  • Partner closely with Amgen's global and cross-functional operations teams to facilitate the efficient execution of patient engagement activities, ensuring operational requirements are effectively communicated, prioritized, and delivered in alignment with enterprise standards, timelines, and stakeholder needs.

  • Oversee day-to-day enterprise patient engagement operations, including project management, resource planning, engagement oversight, process optimization, and reporting.

  • Support the execution of patient engagement communications and storytelling initiatives that elevate patient perspectives, increase visibility of engagement activities, and strengthen internal stakeholder alignment.

  • Manage and ensure patient engagement activities are conducted in accordance with company policies and external regulatory requirements.

  • Partner with internal stakeholders to identify opportunities for innovation, efficiency, and enhanced patient-centered approaches throughout the engagement lifecycle.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is an individual with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 2 years of patient engagement, patient advocacy and/or healthcare policy experience

OR

Master’s degree and 4 years of patient engagement, patient advocacy and/or healthcare policy experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 6 years of patient engagement, patient advocacy and/or healthcare policy experience

OR

Associate’s degree and 10 years of patient engagement, patient advocacy and/or healthcare policy experience

OR

High school diploma / GED and 12 years of patient engagement, patient advocacy and/or healthcare policy experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in patient engagement, patient advocacy, healthcare operations, public affairs, stakeholder engagement, program management, or related fields.

  • Proven ability to build and sustain trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including patient organizations, patient communities, caregivers and other patient community stakeholders.

  • Strong operational and strategic mindset with demonstrated success designing, implementing, and continuously improving enterprise processes, capabilities, and programs.

  • Strategic and operational thinker with demonstrated ability to design, implement, and continuously improve patient engagement enterprise programs, processes, and capabilities that align with organizational objectives.

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional programs or initiatives, including project and timeline management, resource coordination, issue resolution, and execution across multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

  • Working knowledge of healthcare industry compliance, legal, medical, and regulatory considerations related to patient engagement and external stakeholder interactions.

  • Experience developing and optimizing operational processes, governance frameworks, workflows, and performance measures to drive efficiency, consistency, and scalability.

  • Experience working in a global, highly matrixed organization and collaborating across functions, geographies, and business units.

  • Exceptional organizational, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with a demonstrated ability to drive results through operational excellence and continuous improvement.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans
  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

careers.amgen.com

Application deadline

Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.

Sponsorship

Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

raw.description:
VetsEZ is seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Lead to lead software quality and testing activities for an enterprise Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) initiative focused on reducing and ultimately eliminating the use of Social Security Numbers (SSNs) across critical VistA applications.

The initiative will modify workflows, user interfaces, reports, audit records, and data-handling processes across ADT, PCE, AICS, Record Tracking, and VistA Audit Solutions, transitioning applicable functionality toward approved enterprise identifiers while reducing exposure of sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII).

Working closely with VistA developers, Business Analysts, Product Owners, cybersecurity and privacy teams, and Government stakeholders, the QA Lead will establish the overall testing strategy, lead QA execution, coordinate defect management, and ensure software releases meet functional, security, compliance, and quality requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead QA and testing activities across VistA applications and workflows impacted by the SSN reduction initiative.
  • Develop and maintain project-wide test strategies, plans, standards, and priorities based on requirements, risks, dependencies, and release schedules.
  • Lead and mentor QA Analysts through test planning, execution, documentation, defect management, and release validation.
  • Design and oversee functional, integration, regression, security, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Develop and manage test cases and scenarios covering SSN removal, enterprise identifiers, workflow and UI changes, reports, audit records, interfaces, and related functionality.
  • Ensure comprehensive end-to-end test coverage and coordinate testing across development, QA, and business teams.
  • Lead defect triage, prioritization, retesting, and closure while monitoring quality risks and defect trends.
  • Support release-readiness reviews and provide quality recommendations to project leadership and Government stakeholders.
  • Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, defects, and validation results.
  • Ensure testing addresses applicable privacy, PII/PHI, security, and NIST-related requirements and maintain documentation supporting auditability.
  • Coordinate UAT with clinical, administrative, and Government stakeholders.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and provide QA input during requirements and design activities to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are testable.
  • Identify opportunities for test automation and communicate testing status, risks, dependencies, and impediments to project leadership.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of software quality assurance experience supporting healthcare IT or complex enterprise systems.
  • 2+ years of experience as a QA Lead, Test Lead, QA Manager, or comparable quality leadership role.
  • Experience developing and executing comprehensive test strategies across functional, integration, regression, and UAT.
  • Experience with defect management, release validation, requirements traceability, QA metrics, and reporting.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments.
  • Strong knowledge of test case and test script development, test automation concepts, and QA best practices.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to lead and collaborate with distributed QA teams and technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience testing Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) VistA applications.
  • Familiarity with MUMPS-based application environments.
  • Experience with ADT, PCE, AICS, Record Tracking, VistA Audit Solutions, or related VistA applications.
  • Knowledge of PII/PHI handling, HIPAA, NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, and VA privacy and security requirements.
  • Experience implementing or managing automated software testing.
  • Experience supporting Federal healthcare applications or other highly regulated systems.

Security Clearance Requirements:

  • U.S. Citizenship is required.
  • All selected candidates must successfully complete a background check.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Government/Public Trust clearance, including required fingerprinting, when required for the position.

Benefits:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • 401(k) with Employer Match
  • PTO and Federal Holidays
  • Corporate-provided Laptop
  • Training and Professional Development Opportunities
  • Fully Remote Role

Note: Selected candidates will be required to complete fingerprinting at a government facility and undergo a background check as part of the hiring process.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

What You'll Own

1. Logistics & Shipment Coordination

  • Support brokers with day-to-day shipment and logistics coordination.
  • Schedule and confirm pickup and delivery appointments.
  • Perform track-and-trace activities and maintain accurate shipment status updates.
  • Follow up with carriers, drivers, and relevant stakeholders to ensure timely updates.
  • Identify potential delays or issues and escalate them to the appropriate team member.
  • Help ensure shipments move according to schedule and customer expectations.

2. Systems & Data Management

  • Accurately update shipment information, customer records, and operational data in internal systems.
  • Perform routine data entry and maintain accurate records.
  • Update internal dashboards, boards, and operational trackers.
  • Ensure information remains current and accessible to brokers and the broader operations team.
  • Identify discrepancies or missing information and follow up to resolve them.
  • Maintain a high level of accuracy across all operational documentation.

3. Broker & Back-Office Support

  • Provide day-to-day administrative support to brokers so they can focus on customers, carriers, and revenue-generating activities.
  • Assist with documentation, follow-ups, scheduling, and other operational tasks.
  • Monitor outstanding tasks and ensure follow-ups are completed on time.
  • Help identify repetitive administrative work that can be streamlined or improved.
  • Take ownership of assigned workflows and ensure they are completed without constant supervision.

4. Customer & After-Hours Support

As you become more familiar with the business, responsibilities may expand to include:

  • Communicating with customers regarding shipment updates and operational questions.
  • Handling after-hours correspondence when needed.
  • Providing timely updates and ensuring customer issues are escalated appropriately.
  • Developing the confidence and knowledge required to represent the company directly with customers.
  • Supporting basic operational decision-making within established guidelines.

5. Operations & Growth Opportunities

For the right candidate, the role can gradually expand beyond traditional back-office support.

You may have the opportunity to:

  • Take on additional operational responsibilities.
  • Support pricing activities after appropriate training.
  • Assist brokers with more complex shipment coordination.
  • Own specific operational workflows or customer accounts.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes, systems, and efficiency.
  • Become a more integrated member of the company's day-to-day operations team.

Requirements

Required

  • 2+ years of experience in logistics, freight brokerage, transportation, operations, customer support, or a related field.
  • Experience working with logistics, freight, transportation, or shipment coordination is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with shipment tracking, appointment scheduling, carrier/driver communication, or similar logistics workflows.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate information across multiple systems.
  • Comfortable managing multiple tasks, priorities, and moving parts simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Highly organized with strong follow-through and the ability to work independently.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growing business where responsibilities may evolve over time.
  • Technologically proficient and comfortable learning new software and systems.
  • Familiarity with modern AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude and a willingness to use technology to improve productivity.
  • Reliable computer setup with at least 4 GB of RAM and sufficient storage to effectively perform the role.
  • Ability to work during the required business hours, including potential after-hours support as the role develops.

Strong Plus

  • Experience working for a freight brokerage or 3PL.
  • Experience with TMS, transportation management, load boards, or freight management systems.
  • Experience with track and trace and carrier management.
  • Experience communicating directly with US-based customers, carriers, or drivers.
  • Experience supporting brokers in a high-volume environment.
  • Experience with freight pricing or quoting.
  • Experience handling after-hours customer communication.
  • Experience with operational dashboards, reporting, or performance tracking.
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to improve workflows, research information, automate repetitive tasks, or increase productivity.

You Are Not a Fit If

  • You need constant direction to stay on top of routine responsibilities.
  • You struggle to manage multiple shipments, tasks, or priorities at the same time.
  • You are uncomfortable making follow-ups or communicating with customers, carriers, or drivers.
  • You are not detail-oriented when entering or updating operational information.
  • You prefer purely administrative work and are not interested in growing into a broader operations role.
  • You are resistant to learning new systems and technology.
  • You are uncomfortable using AI tools as part of your daily workflow.
  • You wait for problems to be assigned rather than proactively identifying and escalating issues.
  • You are looking for a narrowly defined role with no opportunity to take on additional responsibility.

Benefits

  • Client Relationship: You will be directly working with the client. This means that you will communicate with the client, provide services, and address any client-related matters independently.
  • Payments: All payments for your services will be handled by the client. Elevate and Delegate is not involved in processing your payroll. Your salary will directly go to you.
  • Vacation Leaves and Holidays: While we may have recommendations or guidelines regarding vacation leaves and holidays, the decision is entirely at the discretion of the client. You are expected to align your schedule with the client’s business needs and any specific policies or preferences they may have in this regard.

---

Application Process:

  • As part of your application, you’ll be asked to record your responses to the initial interview questions through a Loom video (questions & instructions are in the application page).
  • Our team will carefully review your submission, and if shortlisted, we’ll share your responses with the client for their review and next steps.
  • Please treat this recording as you would a real interview:

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

  • CDP Discloser
  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies
  • Great Place to Work
  • Sustainability Yearbook S&P Global
