raw.description:
About The Lisinski Law Firm

Since 2020, Lisinski Law Firm has served as a dedicated humanitarian immigration practice committed to providing meaningful support to individuals and families seeking safety, stability, and a path forward. We frequently stand with clients who have been turned away elsewhere, offering both advocacy and care. Joining our Firm means becoming part of a team devoted to keeping families together and “Changing as Many Lives as Possible.”

About the Role

The Product Owner is the day-to-day owner of a defined product or feature set within a broader product area at LLF. They are responsible for the health of their product’s backlog; refining work, authoring clear user stories with acceptance criteria, prioritizing tactically within the sprint cadence, and serving as the primary product voice to IT during execution.

This role focuses on execution, ownership, and operational consistency in a regulated, high-stakes legal services environment. Working in close partnership with Product Managers, IT, the Project Management Office (PMO), and operational stakeholders, the Product Owner ensures that strategic product intent translates into well-formed, well-prioritized work that engineering can deliver predictably. The Product Owner also organizes and drives the "Quick Wins" pipeline for their product area; surfacing, scoping, and shepherding smaller improvements that deliver tangible value alongside larger initiatives.

This role operates as an individual contributor, partnering closely with Product Managers and reporting to a Product Team Lead.

Your Key Contributions

  • Own the day-to-day health of the product backlog for an assigned product or feature set — including authoring and refining user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.
  • Partner with Product Managers to take ownership of epics and break them down into well-formed user stories that can be slotted into the team’s sprint cadence.
  • Organize and drive the Quick Wins pipeline for the assigned product area — surfacing smaller improvements, scoping them appropriately, and shepherding them through delivery.
  • Participate actively in sprint ceremonies (planning, refinement, review, retrospective) as the primary product voice to IT.
  • Tactically prioritize work within the sprint and near-term backlog, making routine trade-off decisions and escalating non-routine ones to the Product Manager or Product Team Lead.
  • Resolve routine execution exceptions — answering engineering questions, refining acceptance criteria, and unblocking story-level ambiguity during the sprint.
  • Validate that delivered work meets acceptance criteria and product intent before sign-off.
  • Maintain operational consistency in how product work is captured, refined, prioritized, and tracked, contributing to team standards and reducing rework.
  • Partner with PMO on sprint-level reporting, dependency tracking, and risk surfacing.
  • Engage with operational and end-user stakeholders to gather feedback, clarify needs, and validate that delivered work solves the intended problem.
  • Ensure work is delivered in a manner consistent with the firm’s regulatory, ethical, and data-handling obligations, escalating to the Product Manager or Legal/Compliance when in doubt.

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum of 1–3 years of experience as a Product Owner, Project Manager, Business Analyst, or in a closely related role contributing to software delivery.
  • Demonstrated experience authoring user stories and acceptance criteria for software products.
  • Demonstrated experience working within an Agile/Scrum environment, including active participation in sprint ceremonies.
  • Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum frameworks and sprint-based software delivery.
  • Proficiency with product/backlog management tooling (e.g., Craft.io, Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent).
  • Strong written documentation skills, particularly user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Comfort working in close partnership with engineering teams on day-to-day execution.
  • Basic understanding of modern software delivery practices and the ability to engage substantively with engineering on story-level scope and trade-offs.

Work Schedule

  • Monday to Friday 9:00 am to 5:00 pm EST.

Equipment Requirements

For PC Users:

  • A modern processor (Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 from the last few years)
  • Windows 11 (kept up to date)

For Mac Users:

  • A modern processor (Apple M1 chip or a recent Intel Core i5)
  • A recent macOS (Ventura or newer)

For Everyone:

  • At least 8 GB of memory (RAM) to run applications smoothly
  • A fast hard drive with sufficient available storage

Our Firm

At Lisinski Law Firm, the commitment we show to our clients is matched by how we support and invest in our people. LLF is a place where employees are encouraged by peers, heard by leadership, and strengthened by a genuinely collaborative team culture. Whether you join Marketing, IT, Accounting, Legal, or any other function, your work matters. Every role contributes to meaningful, lasting impact in the lives of those we serve.

Our Values

At Lisinski Law Firm, we are driven by a client obsessed mindset and a commitment to learning, advocacy, efficiency, and nimbleness in everything we do. We work as true team players, delivering creative problem-solving and high-quality service to support families with excellence and care.

The Radiology Medical Transcription & Diagnostic Reporting QA Analyst is responsible for reviewing, editing, and quality-assuring diagnostic radiology reports and report templates generated through speech-recognition technology.     • Identify missing information, inconsistencies, discrepancies, and potential inaccuracies within diagnostic reports
    • Escalate clinical or documentation discrepancies requiring radiologist review rather than independently altering clinical interpretation

    • Create, edit, maintain, and QA diagnostic reporting templates within speech-recognition/reporting systems

  • Compliance & Documentation
    • Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA, privacy, security, and organizational requirements
    • Follow established documentation and quality-control procedures
    • Maintain appropriate audit trails and documentation of quality findings and corrective actions

  • Experience supporting radiologists across multiple diagnostic modalities
  • Experience reviewing speech-recognition-generated medical documentation
  • Prior experience with PowerScribe 360 strongly preferred
    • Experience with comparable platforms such as M*Modal or other diagnostic speech-recognition/reporting systems may be considered
  • Experience with eRAD RIS, RamSoft, or similar radiology information systems preferred
  • Radiology coding knowledge is beneficial but not required
  • Post-secondary education or formal training in Medical Transcription, Medical Language, Health Information Management, Healthcare Administration, or related discipline preferred
  • Formal coursework in anatomy, physiology, and medical terminology strongly preferred
  • Advanced knowledge of radiology and medical terminology
  • Strong understanding of anatomy and physiology
  • Exceptional listening, proofreading, grammar, and medical-language skills
  • Ability to identify subtle discrepancies and inconsistencies within diagnostic reports
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to documentation accuracy
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities within defined turnaround times
  • Strong computer and word-processing skills
  • Ability to learn new radiology reporting systems and workflows quickly
  • Professional communication skills when interacting with radiologists and operational stakeholders

Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is seeking a remote Principal, Real World Data Sourcing & Partnerships to join our team.

Location: Remote

 

Work Schedule: This is a full‑time, exempt (salaried) position assigned to a First Shift schedule, with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. in your local time zone. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible.

Work Authorization: This position requires permanent authorization to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship (including H-1B, OPT/CPT, EAD, or other temporary work authorization) is not available.

Job Responsibilities

Strategic leadership & execution

  • Work with Global Head RWD Data strategy & technical solutions, as well as the wider RWD team, to identify and support evolving data requirements aligned to strategic ambitions.
  • Independently reviews, understand and communicates key data needs to internal LabCorp teams and potential external partners.
  • Monitor industry, regulatory, and customer trends & innovation to inform strategic adjustments regarding data needs.

Data sourcing & evaluation

  • Lead initiative to identify and evaluate potential data sources ensuring datasets are fit-for-purpose, accessible and usable to assure ROI.
  • Identify new data sources to close gaps in existing products and expand to account for emerging customer needs.
  • Work closely with Data integration, product, technical solution and commercial teams, to understand and support changing data source requirements.
  • Work with colleagues in IT (including Enterprise Architecture, Security and Data Governance) to support vendor qualification and technical assessment of data to inform evaluation.
  • Build relations with internal teams to understand existing and emerging sources of data that can be leveraged by the RWD Team.
  • Flags potential conflict of interest or larger strategic opportunities with data partners.

Operational excellence

  • Ensure data and processes are aligned with global data governance frameworks & ethical data standards.
  • Identify and optimize use of AI tools to enhance operational models and frameworks to support scalability, efficiency, and rigor.
  • Leads and provides updates during participation in internal and external meetings with data partners.
  • Leads process improvement and tool development initiatives to support partners identification, onboarding and management.
  • Maintains comprehensive documentation for all opportunities in Smartsheet, Excel and other tools.
  • Develop and prepare summary reports and dashboards for a range of stakeholders.

Partner management

  • Function as key point of contact between Labcorp RWD team and data partners
  • Clearly communicate Labcorp Real-world data needs to potential partners and lead ongoing interactions with key stakeholders to ensure timeline partnership evaluation.
  • Work with Labcorp stakeholders including legal, regulatory, Compliance, and Data Governance to ensure timely development of partnerships agreement and contracting.
  • Lead onboarding of data partners and act point of contact, establishing clear channels and cadence for communication and actively building relationships with key stakeholders.
  • Lead ongoing reviews of existing data partnerships to assess pros and cons the success of existing data partnership and recommend improvement opportunities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High school diploma or GED with 7 or more years of experience in data partnerships, alliance management, real world data, healthcare data, or life sciences; or Associate degree with 5 or more years of experience in data partnerships, alliance management, real world data, healthcare data or life sciences; or Bachelor's degree in Science, Business, Healthcare, Data Analytics, or Information Systems with 3 or more years of experience in data partnerships, alliance management, real world data, healthcare data, life sciences, or a related field.
  • 3 or more years of experience supporting data partnerships, alliance management, vendor management, or strategic partnerships within the life sciences, healthcare, or real-world data industry.
  • 3 or more years of experience developing, negotiating, implementing, or managing third-party partnership agreements.
  • 3 or more years of experience working with data management tools, systems, or technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Science, Business, Healthcare, Data Analytics, or Information Systems.
  • 2 or more years of experience supporting Real World Data (RWD) or Real World Evidence (RWE) initiatives.
  • 2 or more years of experience evaluating healthcare, clinical, claims, laboratory, or other healthcare-related data sources.
  • 2 or more years of experience partnering with Legal, Compliance, Data Governance, Privacy, or Regulatory functions.
  • 1 or more years of experience supporting process improvement, workflow optimization, or operational excellence initiatives.
  • 1 or more years of experience utilizing AI-enabled productivity tools or technologies.

Additional Job Standards

Industry Knowledge

  • Knowledge of Real World Data, Real World Evidence, and the healthcare or life sciences industry.
  • Knowledge of HIPAA, data privacy laws, and data governance principles.

Communication & Relationship Management

  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate complex information clearly and effectively.

Organization & Execution

  • Strong planning, prioritization, multitasking, and organizational skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Ability to build and maintain tracking, reporting, and documentation processes.

Problem Solving

  • Strong analytical, critical thinking, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to identify issues, evaluate options, and recommend effective solutions.

Collaboration & Professional Effectiveness

  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Demonstrated teamwork and ability to collaborate effectively across functions.
  • Professionalism, persistence, adaptability, and a continuous learning mindset.

About the Role

The Principal, Real World Data Sourcing & Partnerships is responsible for identifying, evaluating, and onboarding strategic data sources and partnerships that support the growth and differentiation of Labcorp's Real World Data portfolio. This role collaborates closely with business, product, technical, governance, legal, and compliance partners to assess new data opportunities, manage partner relationships, and support the development of innovative data products that meet evolving customer needs.

All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data. The position is also eligible for an annual bonus under the Labcorp Bonus Plan. Bonuses are payable based on corporate and/or business segment performance and are subject to individual performance modifiers.

Benefits: Employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(k), Paid Time Off (PTO) or Flexible Time Off (FTO), Tuition Reimbursement and Employee Stock Purchase Plan. ACU is affiliated with the fellowship of the Church of Christ. All qualified applicants for this position must be professing Christians and be willing to support the Christian mission and purpose of the university.

‌

This position supports the program’s mission of preparing Christian scholar-practitioners for ethical, research-informed leadership in diverse organizational contexts. Adjunct Dissertation Chairs and Readers serve as faculty members responsible for guiding and evaluating doctoral student research during the dissertation phase of the EdD in Organizational Leadership program. The Chair serves as the primary mentor and academic guide for the doctoral candidate. The Reader serves as a secondary committee member who provides scholarly review, feedback, and evaluation. Successful applicants will serve in both roles.

1. Major Responsibilities:

Adjunct Dissertation Chair

  • Serve as primary mentor for assigned doctoral candidates.

  • Guide students in developing, revising, and completing dissertation chapters.

  • Ensure alignment of research questions, methodology, analysis, and findings.

  • Conduct regular meetings with students according to program policy.

  • Provide timely, constructive, and substantive feedback on dissertation drafts.

  • Ensure compliance with program templates, research standards, and university IRB requirements.

  • Prepare students for proposal and final defense.

  • Coordinate with Readers and program leadership regarding student progress.

  • Model ethical research practice, including appropriate and responsible use of AI tools consistent with university policy.

Adjunct Dissertation Reader

  • Provide scholarly review and feedback on dissertation chapters.

  • Evaluate research design, methodology, analysis, and academic rigor.

  • Participate in proposal and final defense.

  • Ensure adherence to program standards and dissertation templates.

  • Provide timely and constructive written feedback.

  • Collaborate professionally with the Chair to support student progress.

  • Uphold academic integrity and ethical scholarship standards.

​

2. Essential duties include the following (both roles):

  • Maintain regular, professional communication with students and committee members.

  • Respond to dissertation submissions within established turnaround expectations.

  • Follow all EdD in Organizational Leadership program policies, research standards, and committee procedures.

  • Avoid inappropriate AI usage in reviewing or generating student feedback.

  • Maintain confidentiality of student research and academic records.

  • Participate in required faculty development and dissertation training sessions.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

​

Qualifications:

Professional

  • Earned Ph.D., Ed.D., or other terminal degree in Organizational Leadership or a closely related leadership discipline.

  • Experience conducting original research.

  • Experience chairing or serving on dissertation committees preferred.

  • Demonstrated expertise in qualitative and/or quantitative research methodologies.

  • Experience teaching or mentoring graduate-level students preferred.

  • Strong academic writing and scholarly review skills.

Personal

  • Professionalism and collegiality in committee collaboration.

  • Strong written communication skills.

  • Ability to provide direct, constructive academic feedback.

  • Organizational discipline and responsiveness.

  • Commitment to ethical scholarship and student success.

Physical Demands:

  • Majority of work is performed in front of a computer and on the telephone; must have the ability to use the computer and remain stationary for long periods.

  • Manage conversations in person, online, and by telephone.

  • Work well under pressure and manage stress well.

  • Communicate clearly: speak, read, write, and hear clearly to perform essential functions.

Project Coordinator (Asana, Trello & Operations) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (flexibility for deadlines)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Project Coordinator to bring structure, accountability, and visibility across multiple projects and operational workflows.

This is not a passive administrative role. You’ll help keep projects on track by managing timelines, coordinating stakeholders, tracking deliverables, identifying risks, and maintaining organized documentation.

If you’re highly organized, proactive, and enjoy keeping teams aligned and projects moving forward, this role is a great fit.

What You’ll Do

Project Planning & Timeline Management

  • Maintain project plans using Asana, Trello, Monday.com, MS Project, or Smartsheet.
  • Track timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.
  • Keep project schedules and trackers accurate and up to date.
  • Help teams stay aligned on priorities and deadlines.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Prepare meeting agendas, notes, action items, and weekly project reports.
  • Maintain organized documentation in SharePoint, Google Drive, or Confluence.
  • Track project progress, risks, blockers, and key metrics.
  • Ensure documentation remains accurate and accessible.

Communication & Coordination

  • Act as the central point of coordination between project managers, team members, leadership, and stakeholders.
  • Follow up on tasks and deliverables proactively.
  • Escalate delays, blockers, or risks before they impact project timelines.
  • Ensure decisions and updates are clearly documented.

Task & Resource Tracking

  • Monitor task completion, resource availability, and project dependencies.
  • Help maintain accountability across active projects.
  • Ensure deliverables stay on schedule.

Risk & Vendor Management

  • Identify delays, bottlenecks, and operational risks.
  • Maintain project risk logs and escalation tracking.
  • Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and external stakeholders.
  • Track vendor deliverables and escalate issues when needed.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in:
    • Project Coordination
    • Operations Support
    • Administrative or Project Support roles
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Asana
    • Trello
    • Monday.com
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including:
    • Project trackers
    • Pivot tables
    • Conditional formatting
  • Excellent organizational, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Comfortable working remotely across multiple stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • PMP, CAPM, or Agile certifications (or currently pursuing them).
  • Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, or sprint planning.
  • Experience in SaaS, marketing, professional services, construction, or operations-focused environments.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Update project plans and task trackers.
  • Follow up with teams on deadlines and deliverables.
  • Support meetings with notes and action items.
  • Prepare weekly project status reports.
  • Coordinate communication across stakeholders.
  • Identify and escalate project risks.
  • Maintain organized project documentation.

In short: You’ll ensure projects stay organized, on schedule, and visible while helping teams execute efficiently.

Key Metrics for Success

  • On-time completion of tasks and milestones.
  • Accurate and consistent project reporting.
  • Fewer missed deadlines due to coordination gaps.
  • Organized and up-to-date project documentation.
  • Positive stakeholder feedback on communication and execution.

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Practical Assessment (Project Tracker & Status Report)
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your project coordination experience, and share how you’ve managed timelines, stakeholders, documentation, and project tracking tools like Asana or Trello. Your video will be reviewed before moving forward in the interview process.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

Apply Now

If you enjoy keeping projects organized, coordinating teams, and ensuring work gets delivered on time, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help drive successful project execution in a fast-paced remote environment.

Job Description

Global Study Lead – This position is a fully client-embedded role, dedicated to a leading bio-pharma company.

This GSL is a single accountable person and a Clinical Operations representative. Will drive operational strategy, planning and leading the study and being aligned with the asset strategy. The GSL and GSM work s a leadership-operational duo.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Overall Study Leadership

  • Own the day-to-day management of the global clinical study

  • Lead cross-functional study teams (clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, medical monitoring, regulatory, supply chain, safety, etc.)

  • Ensure alignment between global strategy and regional execution

  • Develop and maintain:

    • study timelines

    • operational plans

    • risk management plans

    • enrollment strategies

  • Oversee country start-up, site activation, recruitment, monitoring, and closeout

  • Ensure protocol execution is consistent globally

3. Vendor and CRO Oversight

  • Manage external vendors and CRO partners

  • Track performance metrics and service quality

  • Resolve operational issues and escalations

  • Ensure vendors meet contractual obligations and timelines

  • Monitor study budgets and forecasts

  • Track study spend against plan

  • Identify resource gaps and operational risks

  • Support financial governance and change management

5. Risk and Issue Management

  • Identify study risks early

  • Lead mitigation and contingency planning

  • Handle escalations related to:

    • recruitment delays

    • protocol deviations

    • data quality issues

    • supply shortages

    • inspection readiness

6. Regulatory and Quality Compliance

  • Ensure study conduct follows:

    • ICH-GCP

    • local regulations

    • SOPs

    • protocol requirements

  • Support inspection readiness and audit activities

  • Oversee CAPAs when needed

  • Serve as the central operational contact for the study

  • Communicate updates to:

    • senior leadership

    • study teams

    • regional teams

    • sponsors/partners

  • Lead governance meetings and study reviews

8. Data and Study Oversight

  • Monitor enrollment, data cleaning, query resolution, and database lock readiness

  • Review KPIs and operational metrics

  • Make operational decisions that impact study delivery

  • Recommend process improvements and efficiencies

- Bachelor’s degree: life sciences or related discipline; The role will require a good understanding of complex clinical development and regulatory processes.

  • Previous in-depth Oncology experience

  • Must have exposed to clinical study management “end-to-end” Globally : NA, EMEA, APAC, LATAM – China & Japan, Africa is an asset –

  • Must have proven experience from study feasibility to CSR

  • Must have at least Ph II and PIII experience – PI & PIV is an asset

  • Must have cross-functional leadership proven experience, able to drive internal and external meeting

  • Able to input in clinical protocol, ICF, and other study plan, savvy in clinical study risk management and clinical systems

  • Strong experience in clinical budget management

  • Strong experience with vendor management including CRO

  • Exposed to competent authority Inspections (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA...), being involved in studies pivotal for drug file registration is an asset

  • Fluent in English, to the level they can negotiate and discuss (adapt message) related to complex topics with any Clinical team member (Local country representative, Statistician, Data Manager, laboratory, central laboratory, Scientific writer, safety representative, study Phycician and any type of vendors as well as able to present clear status to upper management if required.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills (oral and written), outstanding interpersonal skills.

  • Demonstrates leadership skills, promoting motivation and empowerment of others in order to accomplish individual, team and organizational objectives

  • Strong understanding of the clinical study, drug development, sample management and other associated process and quality requirements, including ICH/GCP guidelines and SOPs

Job Description:

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Data Engineering & Streaming Specialist (Pre-sales /Customer facing)

Are you passionate about making data and AI use cases accessible for enterprise clients?

Cloudera is seeking a pre-sales customer-facing, hands-on Data Engineering & Streaming Specialist to join our team in the US. In this pivotal role, you'll leverage your deep technical expertise to empower our customers, influence product direction, and drive success across our most impactful data engineering, real-time streaming, and AI readiness use cases. If you thrive on creative freedom and shaping the future of cloud-native data architectures and AI at scale, we encourage you to apply.

As a Data Engineering & Streaming Specialist, You Will (Responsibilities)

  • Lead customer engagements by designing and presenting scalable, cloud-native data engineering architectures and business outcomes to technical and executive stakeholders.

  • Provide deep domain expertise throughout the sales cycle, supporting PoCs, solution sizing, and adoption for new and existing customers focusing on data prep, CDC, streaming use cases, and AI readiness.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues in data pipelines, providing guidance and leading escalations to ensure customer success.

  • Drive internal and external technical enablement by exploring new cloud-native streaming and batch technologies, developing educational materials, and sharing best practices.

  • Influence product roadmap by translating customer feedback and EMEA-specific requirements into actionable insights for our product and engineering teams.

  • Act as a Cloudera evangelist, participating in community activities, speaking at events, and contributing to knowledge sharing around modern, AI-ready data engineering.

  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (Sales, Product, Engineering) to align on customer success and product vision.

We’re excited about you if you have:

  • Proven experience leading and implementing mission-critical data use cases in industries such as Financial Services, Retail, Healthcare, Public Sector, etc.

  • Proven experience in designing, building, and deploying enterprise-grade data engineering pipelines and real-time streaming solutions on modern, cloud-native data architectures.

  • Hands-on expertise with leading data processing and streaming technologies, specifically Apache Spark, Airflow, Apache NiFi, Apache Flink, and Apache Kafka.

  • Strong background in architecting production data deployments across hybrid and multi-cloud environments, with specific expertise in data preparation, Change Data Capture (CDC), and data ingestion at massive scale.

  • Demonstrated ability to run Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and MVPs that lead to successful, enterprise-grade production deployments, ensuring data pipelines are optimized for AI readiness.

  • Practical experience in designing and implementing data-intensive use cases, including navigating the associated security, data quality, and governance challenges required to build an AI-ready data foundation.

  • Exceptional presentation skills, comfortable engaging with diverse audiences from data engineers to senior executives.

  • Ability to analyse customer data workloads and define technical migration or modernization roadmaps tailored to their specific needs.

You'll Be Well-Positioned for Success If You Bring (Bonus Qualifications):

  • Prior experience in pre-sales or technical consulting roles with a strong focus on big data & AI platform solutions.

  • Direct experience with legacy or competing streaming/data engineering platforms (e.g., Confluent, Databricks, AWS EMR/Glue) and advising customers/partners on migration strategies to cloud-native alternatives.

  • Experience with DataOps, including CI/CD for data pipelines and automated data quality frameworks essential for trusted AI.

  • Experience with, and interest in, open-source software and development practices.

  • Familiarity with Cloudera's Data Engineering (CDE) and DataFlow (CDF) components, as well as Shared Data Experience (SDX).

  • Relevant technical certifications (e.g., Databricks Certified Data Engineer, Confluent Certified Developer, AWS Certified Data Analytics).

  • Working knowledge of the broader open-source data and AI ecosystem, particularly open table formats that drive cloud-native architectures (e.g., Apache Iceberg) and container orchestration (Kubernetes).

  • Deep understanding of the data engineering prerequisites required for machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI applications.

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

California: $166,000 - $230,000

Colorado: $146,000- $180,000

Illinois: $154,000- $190,000

Individual compensation within the published range is determined by the candidate's skills, experience, qualifications, and primary work location. Senior Service and UX Designer, Government Digital Transformation

Full-time Contract | Remote within Canada | Alberta Business Hours

About the opportunity

Aequilibrium is seeking a Senior Service and UX Designer for a potential multi-year public-sector digital modernization initiative.

You will help improve complex internal, partner-facing, and public-facing digital services supporting housing programs across Alberta. The environment includes an enterprise Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform, a Partner Portal and related digital services.

This is a senior, hands-on role combining service design, user research, enterprise UX, accessible interface design and stakeholder facilitation. You will work within a cross-functional Agile team alongside product managers, business analysts, developers, architects and government stakeholders.

The initial contract is expected to run from November 2026 to November 2027, with the potential for two additional one-year extensions. The successful candidate must reside and work in Canada and be available full-time during Alberta business hours.

Compensation

The anticipated contractor rate for this role is $80–$100 per hour, depending on experience, public-sector qualifications, and alignment with the required service-design capabilities. The engagement is expected to be full-time, with approximately 2,000 hours anticipated annually. The initial one-year contract may be extended for up to two additional one-year terms; extensions and annual hours are subject to client approval and are not guaranteed.

What you will do

  • Lead human-centered design across internal, partner-facing and public-facing digital services.

  • Plan and conduct user research, including interviews, discovery workshops, usability testing, surveys and behavioral analysis.

  • Map complex service ecosystems and develop current-state and future-state journey maps and service blueprints.

  • Translate research, user needs and business requirements into information architecture, user flows, wireframes and interactive prototypes.

  • Design intuitive, responsive and accessible interfaces for enterprise web applications and portals.

  • Create and maintain enterprise design systems, including component libraries, design tokens and interaction standards.

  • Apply WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility requirements throughout research, design and implementation.

  • Facilitate design-thinking, co-design and stakeholder-alignment workshops.

  • Collaborate closely with product, business, architecture, development and quality-assurance teams within an Agile environment.

  • Prepare production-ready design specifications and support developer handoff, implementation and design QA.

  • Use usability metrics, analytics and user feedback to measure outcomes and guide continuous improvement.

  • Provide design leadership while remaining actively involved in research and design delivery.

What we are looking for

The following experience is required:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience delivering UX, UI and service design within complex enterprise environments.

  • 5+ years supporting digital transformation within government, the broader public sector or Crown corporations.

  • A post-secondary degree or diploma in interaction design, human-computer interaction, UX design, product design, industrial design, graphic design, computer science or a related discipline.

  • Demonstrated experience designing responsive enterprise applications, portals or complex digital-service platforms.

  • Strong human-centered service-design experience, including user research, journey mapping, service blueprinting and current-state and future-state service modeling.

  • Experience designing citizen-facing, partner-facing or internal enterprise digital services.

  • Experience developing or governing enterprise design systems, component libraries and design tokens.

  • Demonstrated application of WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards.

  • Experience preparing production-ready specifications and supporting implementation through developer handoff and design QA.

  • Strong stakeholder-facilitation and design-leadership capabilities.

  • Experience working with cross-functional Agile delivery teams.

  • Proficiency with Figma, Miro, and FigJam, as well as Jira or Confluence.

  • Ability to work full-time during Alberta business hours, approximately 8:15 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Mountain Time.

Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, government case-management platforms, partner portals, housing, social services, or similarly complex service environments would be especially valuable.

When applying

Please include:

  • Your current résumé.

  • Your location within Canada.

  • Your availability to begin November 2, 2026.

  • Your hourly contract rate.

  • A summary of your government and public-sector digital-transformation experience, including clients, dates, and your responsibilities.

  • Two examples demonstrating human-centered service design and user research.

  • Two examples involving enterprise UX, design systems and accessibility.

  • Two examples involving citizen-facing, partner-facing or internal digital services.

  • Confirmation that you can provide three client references.

For each example, clearly describe the project, your personal contribution, the research and design methods used, the deliverables you produced, and the resulting outcomes.

This is a project-based opportunity on an AI training platform — not a job. No fixed hours, no commitment beyond what fits your schedule. You record, you get paid.

We're looking for people to record point-of-view videos of everyday household activities. You mount your smartphone on your head, go about your routine, and the camera captures exactly what you see. These videos help train AI systems and robots to understand how people interact with objects in real-world environments.

Do you wash dishes every day? Vacuum the rug? Walk the dog? Fold laundry? What if you could get paid just for recording it?

Responsibilities

  • Record everyday household activities from a first-person perspective — cooking, cleaning, tidying up, folding laundry, gardening, walking the dog, and more
  • Record in your own home, yard, garage, or workspace
  • Follow short recording guidelines per session
  • Upload videos through the project app

Requirements

  • Equipment: Own or use a smartphone or alternative camera device capable of 30 FPS or greater and 1080p resolution or greater. iPhone 12 or newer, Google Pixel 6+, or Samsung Galaxy S21+ (must have a wide-angle / 0.5x lens)
  • Capture method: Mount the device at forehead or eye-level for an egocentric perspective, maintaining a downward angle to maximize hand visibility.
  • Software: Utilize the designated "D&A" application for all data capture and upload.
  • Quality control: Ensure all video footage is clear, stable, well-lit, at least 15 seconds long, and accurately depicts useful, intentional tasks without unnecessary pauses or contrived movements.

Why is this freelance opportunity a great fit for you?

• Earn while you do your household chores: up to $6 per hour equivalent depending on the project

• This is project-based freelance work — pick up recording sessions when they fit your schedule

• Influence the future of how AI and robots understand and interact with the real world

Facet was founded in 2016 on the belief that objective, personalized financial advice is essential to living well. Our mission is to empower people to live more enriched lives by delivering a new standard of advice. By removing asset minimums, we provide holistic planning that goes far beyond investments to address every way money impacts life. Our team of CFP® professionals are at the core of our service and are empowered by our best-in-class support teams and proprietary technology platform. This model allows Facet to integrate advice into our members’ entire financial picture—all for an affordable, flat membership fee.

Our commitment to innovation and member success has earned national recognition, including being ranked the #1 Best Financial Advisory Firm 2025 by USA TODAY and named to Newsweek’s list of America’s Top Financial Advisory Firms 2025. With an A+ BBB Rating and a Trustpilot “Excellent” score (as of Sept. 16, 2025)*, we are proud to be redefining the industry for our members and our team alike.

Facet is seeking a Trading Specialist to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just be pushing trade orders in the background—you will serve as the trusted trading Subject Matter Expert (SME) who speaks directly with members and financial planners.

You will guide members through complex trading discussions, educate them on order types, trade scenarios, tax implications, and portfolio adjustments, and help them navigate market transactions with confidence. By blending deep technical trading knowledge with exceptional, human-centered service, the Trading Specialist empowers Facet members to understand how and why trading strategies impact their broader financial journey.

Key Responsibilities:

Member Consultation & Direct Support:

  • Trade & Options Guidance: Serve as the primary point of contact for members seeking in-depth discussions regarding trade execution, order types, cost basis implications, and portfolio rebalancing.
  • Member Education: Educate members on brokerage features, market mechanics, trading rules, IRA transaction guidelines, tax-loss harvesting concepts, and complex money movement.
  • Complex Inquiry Resolution: Address and resolve elevated member inquiries regarding order status, trade discrepancies, cost basis adjustments, and corporate actions with clarity and empathy.

Collaboration & Strategy Execution:

  • Planner & Investment Team Partnership: Partner closely with Facet’s CFP® Financial Planners to evaluate member portfolios, discuss trade options, and align execution workflows with members' holistic financial plans.
  • Trade Workflow & Custodian Support: Facilitate and monitor trade requests, model adjustments, and rebalancing activities across custodian platforms (e.g., Schwab, Fidelity, Apex).
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Act as an internal trading authority for customer support and planning teams on managed account mechanics, direct indexing concepts, and multi-sleeve portfolio structures.

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement:

  • Process Enhancement: Identify opportunities to streamline member trading interactions, improve self-service education, and enhance internal trade escalation workflows.
  • Special Projects: Participate in investment operations initiatives, trading software enhancements, and new platform feature rollouts.

Requirements

Experience & Technical Skills:

raw.description:
Senior Manager, SEO & GEO

Search Engine Optimization & Generative Engine Optimization | Parallels

Push the boundaries of discovery. In your sweatpants.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager of SEO & GEO to lead the next evolution of organic discovery at Parallels.

This role will own our strategy across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. SEO remains a critical growth engine for Parallels - driving visibility, qualified traffic, customer acquisition, and category authority. At the same time, discovery is rapidly expanding into generative AI experiences, where customers increasingly ask tools like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and Copilot what to buy, how to solve problems, and which products to trust.

The Senior Manager of SEO & GEO will ensure Parallels continues to win in search today while building a leadership position in the AI-driven discovery channels of tomorrow.

This is a strategic, hands-on leadership role for someone who has deep SEO expertise and is excited to define the emerging GEO playbook. You will strengthen our technical SEO foundation, scale our content and authority strategy, and lead the company approach to improving how Parallels is surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended by AI-powered platforms.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, Analytics, Communications, and Channel teams to make Parallels more discoverable across the full customer journey - from traditional search queries to AI-generated recommendations.

Your team is global and works across multiple time zones, so comfort with remote work and asynchronous collaboration is critical. Understanding the virtualization space, developer ecosystem, Apple ecosystem, enterprise productivity landscape, and partner routes-to-market will be a strong advantage.

Why This Role Matters

Search is not going away. It remains one of the most important ways customers discover, compare, and choose technology products.

But search is changing.

Customers are increasingly moving from keyword searches to AI-assisted recommendations, conversational answers, and generated product comparisons. That makes SEO more important, not less - because strong technical foundations, authoritative content, structured knowledge, and trusted third-party signals are also what help AI systems understand and recommend a brand.

This role exists to help Parallels win across both dimensions: the proven SEO channels that drive growth today and the emerging GEO channels that will shape customer discovery tomorrow.

What You Will Do

Lead the Integrated SEO & GEO Strategy

  • Own Parallels global organic discovery strategy across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Set the roadmap for SEO and GEO initiatives tied to measurable business outcomes, including qualified traffic, conversion, pipeline influence, brand authority, and AI search visibility.
  • Balance near-term SEO performance with long-term GEO leadership as discovery behavior evolves.
  • Establish Parallels operating model for how SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Content, Engineering, PR, Channel, and Analytics work together.
  • Lead prioritization, planning, reporting, and executive communication for SEO and GEO initiatives.

Build Parallels GEO Leadership

  • Define and operationalize Parallels Generative Engine Optimization strategy.
  • Improve how Parallels products are surfaced, summarized, cited, compared, and recommended in AI-powered discovery experiences.
  • Monitor Parallels presence across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, and emerging AI assistants.
  • Build strategies around entity authority, semantic relevance, structured knowledge, citation visibility, AI retrievability, and recommendation share-of-voice.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to increase high-quality third-party mentions, citations, and category authority.
  • Develop practical measurement frameworks for GEO where attribution is still evolving.
  • Identify how AI-driven discovery is changing customer journeys, competitive positioning, and purchase consideration.

Strengthen SEO as a Core Growth Engine

  • Lead technical SEO across crawlability, indexing, rendering, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, internal linking, structured data, and international SEO.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure SEO requirements are embedded into product launches, site changes, and platform decisions.
  • Drive content SEO strategy across priority audiences including prosumers, developers, power users, gamers, small and mid-size businesses, enterprise buyers, and channel partners.
  • Improve organic acquisition through better intent mapping, content quality, conversion pathways, and authority building.
  • Ensure Parallels continues to perform strongly in traditional search while preparing for the future of AI-mediated discovery.
  • Diagnose and resolve SEO performance issues across large-scale web properties.

Drive Content, Authority & Discoverability

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate product capabilities, launches, roadmap themes, and use cases into discoverable narratives.
  • Build topic authority across virtualization, Windows on Mac, Apple enterprise adoption, developer workflows, gaming, productivity, managed devices, and cross-platform work.
  • Create content and information architecture that serves both human buyers and AI retrieval systems.
  • Support digital PR and partner/channel content strategies that increase trusted references to Parallels across the web.
  • Use AI tools responsibly to accelerate research, content optimization, competitive analysis, and workflow efficiency.
  • Help simplify complex technical messages into clear, compelling stories for customers, partners, and search/discovery platforms.

Lead Measurement, Experimentation & Executive Communication

  • Define clear KPIs for both SEO and GEO, including traffic, rankings, conversions, technical health, content performance, brand visibility, AI citations, and recommendation presence.
  • Build test-and-learn frameworks for GEO experiments.
  • Translate complex changes in search and AI discovery into clear business implications for executives.
  • Use data to prioritize investments and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Manage SEO/GEO tools, vendors, agencies, and reporting systems as needed.

What You Bring

Required

  • 6+ years leading SEO, organic growth, search strategy, or discoverability programs.
  • Deep technical SEO expertise with a proven record of improving organic growth at scale.
  • Strong understanding of content strategy, authority building, information architecture, and search intent.
  • Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience with AI-driven discovery, GEO, LLM-powered search, or emerging search experiences.
  • Ability to define a new discipline while continuing to operate and improve a mature SEO function.
  • Experience influencing Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Content, Analytics, Communications, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort building reporting frameworks where measurement is imperfect.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on familiarity with enterprise SEO and analytics tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Looker/Tableau, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog, Botify, Conductor, BrightEdge, Similarweb, or comparable platforms.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives across teams and time zones.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience in SaaS, developer tools, virtualization, enterprise productivity, managed devices, or infrastructure technology.
  • Understanding of Apple, Windows, Mac, developer, SMB, enterprise, and partner/channel ecosystems.
  • Familiarity with semantic search, entity optimization, structured data, knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, and AI citation behavior.
  • Experience working with GEO tools that monitor AI search visibility, brand mentions, citations, and recommendation share-of-voice across platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
  • Experience using modern AI tools for research, content analysis, workflow automation, and experimentation.
  • Experience managing agencies, vendors, or distributed teams.
  • Comfort working in a global, remote-first environment with asynchronous collaboration.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 12 months, this leader will:

  • Maintain and improve SEO performance as a major organic acquisition channel.
  • Establish a clear GEO strategy, measurement model, and operating rhythm.
  • Improve Parallels visibility and recommendation presence across AI-powered discovery platforms.
  • Strengthen technical SEO foundations and content authority across priority product and audience segments.
  • Build durable collaboration between SEO, GEO, Product Marketing, Engineering, Content, Communications, Channel, and Analytics.
  • Create a repeatable experimentation framework for AI-driven discovery.
  • Position Parallels to win as traditional search and AI-driven discovery continue to converge.

About Parallels

Parallels is a global leader in cross-platform solutions, enabling businesses and individuals to access and use the applications, files, and workflows they need on any device or operating system.

Parallels helps customers get the best out of the technology they choose - whether that is Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, iOS, Android, or the cloud. Our products serve individuals, developers, power users, small and mid-size businesses, enterprises, public sector organizations, and educators who need simple, reliable, and cost-effective ways to work across platforms.

Parallels is best known for making complex technology feel simple. We solve deep engineering and user-experience challenges so customers can run the applications they need, where and how they need them - from Windows on Mac to managed enterprise environments and flexible hybrid work setups.

We have millions of users globally and decades of innovation behind us. Today, Parallels is focused on helping customers stay productive in a world where work happens across devices, operating systems, clouds, and increasingly AI-powered workflows.

We offer a fully remote workspace and flexible hours because we believe great work can happen anywhere. Our team is global, collaborative, and built around motivated people who care about solving meaningful customer problems.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Parallels is committed to building an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment and selection process and work environment. We offer equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, age, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetics, or any other protected characteristic.

If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations required during the recruitment process. Appropriate accommodations will be provided upon request as required by applicable law and company policy. Any information received relating to accommodations will be treated as confidential.

With 20+ hospitals, outpatient clinics, ambulatory care centers and outreach locations across the globe, we provide excellent care to children up to age 18 regardless of their family’s ability to pay or insurance status. Please click here to learn more about our locations.

Job Description

The Professional Billing Specialist (Anesthesia) is responsible for managing all professional billing requirements and managing accounts receivable tasks according to standard and productivity measurements. Responsible to ensure all regulatory and payor guidelines are followed. ​

Key Responsibilities:

  • Coordinating payor denial and appeal follow up activities to ensure timely response from third party payors and the processing of all payor denials, documentation requests and appeals

  • Review all denial accounts for categorization, level of appeal, special requirements for initiating appeals

  • Communicate global payer issues with the payer relations team.

  • Monitor all Claim Edit and Denial Management work queues and lists to ensure they are fully resolved.

  • Ensure medical records requests are completed and submitted within 48 hours.

  • Track all denials on a database to determine outcome. Collecting/analyzing, report status, metrics and trends of activity by different reviews from the tool. Distributing reports on a routine basis to specific distribution group.

  • Organizing all data and activity in a retrievable way to ensure timely follow up on appeals to third party payors. Assisting with the coordination of denial and review activities and materials for committee meetings, including analyses, reports, etc.

  • Knowledgeable about federal, state and third-party claims processing. Supporting projects and initiatives of the Billing and Denials Management teams. This may include coordinating meetings, conducting research for payor criteria, and preparing documents

  • Thorough understanding of managed care payment methodologies and the principles of managed care.

  • Certification in Epic PB Resolute - or agree to obtain certification within 12 months after hire

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent combination of education and experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of SQL or Crystal Reports.

  • HFMA’s CRCR credential

Customer Support | Phone | Email | Live Chat | Ticketing Systems

About the Role

At Pavago, we’re hiring on behalf of one of our clients for a Customer Service Representative (CSR) to deliver exceptional customer support across phone, email, live chat, and ticketing platforms.

This is a customer-first role where you’ll be responsible for:

  • Resolving customer inquiries
  • Managing support tickets
  • Troubleshooting issues
  • Maintaining customer satisfaction
  • Delivering timely, professional communication

You’ll serve as the frontline voice of the company, ensuring every customer receives a positive, solutions-focused experience while helping strengthen customer loyalty and retention.

If you enjoy helping people, solving problems, and working in a fast-paced support environment, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Customer Support & Issue Resolution

  • Handle inbound customer inquiries through:
    • Phone
    • Email
    • Live chat
    • Support tickets
  • Resolve customer concerns professionally and efficiently.
  • Troubleshoot common issues and escalate complex cases when necessary.
  • Deliver timely, high-quality customer support.
  • Manage multiple customer conversations while maintaining service quality.

Ticket & Case Management

  • Manage customer support tickets using platforms such as:
    • Zendesk
    • Freshdesk
    • Help Scout
    • Salesforce Service Cloud
  • Prioritize cases based on:
    • Urgency
    • SLA requirements
    • Business impact
  • Maintain accurate documentation of:
    • Customer interactions
    • Troubleshooting steps
    • Case resolutions
  • Monitor open cases through completion.

Customer Experience & Communication

  • Communicate clearly and professionally across all support channels.
  • De-escalate challenging customer situations with empathy and professionalism.
  • Build trust through proactive communication and consistent follow-up.
  • Capture customer feedback and identify recurring support trends.
  • Maintain a customer-first approach in every interaction.

Knowledge Base & Process Improvement

  • Maintain and update:
    • FAQs
    • Internal knowledge base articles
    • Support documentation
  • Improve:
    • Response templates
    • Support macros
    • Workflow documentation
  • Share recurring customer issues and improvement recommendations with internal teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with:
    • Operations
    • Billing
    • Technical Support
    • Product teams
  • Coordinate escalations and ensure smooth issue resolution.
  • Follow company policies, documentation standards, and privacy requirements.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 1–2 years of experience in:
    • Customer Service
    • Customer Support
    • Call Center
    • Client-facing roles
  • Experience using customer support platforms such as:
    • Zendesk
    • Freshdesk
    • Salesforce Service Cloud
    • Help Scout
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent multitasking and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage high ticket volumes while maintaining quality.
  • Proficiency with:
    • Google Workspace
    • Microsoft Office
  • Reliable internet connection and professional remote workspace.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting U.S.-based customers.
  • Background in:
    • SaaS
    • E-commerce
    • Healthcare
    • Finance
    • Service-based businesses
  • Familiarity with:
    • Live chat platforms
    • Customer support automation tools
    • KPI-driven support environments
  • Multilingual communication skills.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You genuinely enjoy helping customers and solving problems.
  • You remain calm under pressure.
  • You communicate clearly and professionally.
  • You manage multiple priorities efficiently.
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized.
  • You take ownership of customer issues until they are fully resolved.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review and prioritize incoming support tickets.
  • Respond to customers via phone, email, and live chat.
  • Troubleshoot customer issues and coordinate escalations.
  • Document customer interactions and update support records.
  • Follow up on unresolved cases.
  • Identify recurring issues and recommend service improvements.

In short: You deliver fast, professional, and solution-oriented customer support that strengthens customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • First Contact Resolution (FCR)
  • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
  • Net Promoter Score (NPS)
  • Average response time
  • Average resolution time
  • SLA compliance
  • Ticket quality and documentation accuracy
  • Quality assurance (QA) performance

Why Join Us?

  • High-impact customer-facing role.
  • Opportunity to strengthen customer experience operations.
  • Exposure to modern customer support platforms and workflows.
  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior Customer Support Representative
    • Customer Success Specialist
    • Team Lead
    • Operations Support

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Practical Assessment (Customer Support Scenarios or Simulated Tickets)
  4. Client Interview with Support Leadership
  5. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about helping customers, thrive in fast-paced support environments, and take pride in delivering outstanding service, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help create exceptional customer experiences every day.

raw.description:
AI2IO helps organizations navigate the complex landscape of technology solutions, from foundational IT services and system support to advanced software integration, automation, and cutting-edge AI implementations. Our expertise spans IT infrastructure management, custom software development, seamless system integrations, and optimization of low-code business automation, empowering clients to maximize their existing technology investments.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title

Software Engineer Technical Lead

Position Location

Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

Job Summary

ai2io is seeking a Software Engineer Technical Lead with deep C#/.NET, Microsoft Azure, and ASP.NET Blazor experience to own the technical direction and engineering outcomes of a software team. Blazor is our strategic web-application platform. You will remain a hands-on contributor while guiding architecture, delivery, production readiness, secure engineering, and team capability across our Microsoft-centric stack.

The current application portfolio also includes React applications that ai2io must responsibly maintain while planning and executing their transition to C#/.NET and Blazor. Strong React and TypeScript experience is therefore important for sustaining business continuity, stabilizing inherited applications, understanding their behavior and dependencies, and leading deliberate migrations without disrupting users or critical workflows. This role is not intended to establish React as a long-term parallel platform.

Experience with Revit, electrical or mechanical engineering, BIM, MEP workflows, or the broader architecture, engineering, and construction industry is valuable because many ai2io products support specialized engineering work, but that domain experience is not required.

Essential Functions

This role combines hands-on leadership of the strategic .NET and Blazor platform with accountable stewardship of transitional React applications, including their reliable operation and planned conversion.

Own Technical Direction for the Strategic Platform

  • Serve as the team's primary technical decision-maker for solutions built with C#/.NET, ASP.NET Blazor, Microsoft Azure, SQL Server, Microsoft Graph API, Entra ID, and related Microsoft technologies.
  • Lead design for new features and systems and guide teams toward C#/.NET and Blazor for ongoing development unless an approved exception is warranted.
  • Produce durable architecture decision records, system diagrams, API contracts, migration guidance, and implementation plans that engineers can execute against.
  • Define and enforce coding standards, pull-request practices, definition of done, automated testing expectations, accessibility, documentation, and the engineering quality bar.
  • Remain hands-on in production C#, Blazor, Azure, and targeted React/TypeScript work where continuity, diagnosis, or migration risk requires direct contribution.

Maintain Transitional React Applications

  • Own the technical health of React applications while ai2io is responsible for their continued operation, including defect resolution, dependency updates, security findings, diagnostics, testing, and production support.
  • Quickly assess inherited React applications, documenting architecture, build and deployment processes, dependencies, data flows, integrations, ownership gaps, operational risks, and critical business workflows.
  • Prioritize stabilization work that protects users and business continuity without expanding avoidable long-term investment in the transitional React platform.
  • Establish sufficient React and TypeScript coding, testing, review, and release practices to maintain inherited applications safely through their remaining lifecycle.
  • Identify unsupported, fragile, or high-risk components early and present clear mitigation and migration options.

Lead React-to-Blazor Conversion

Plan and Coordinate Technical Delivery

  • Communicate business-continuity and migration tradeoffs clearly, bringing evidence and recommended options rather than status alone.

Own Azure Production Readiness

  • Own team-level readiness for Azure-hosted releases, including deployment planning, observability, diagnostics, rollback considerations, support documentation, and resolution of material technical risks.
  • Guide appropriate use of Azure application, data, identity, integration, storage, secrets, and monitoring services in alignment with organizational standards.
  • Lead investigation of significant production issues across Blazor and transitional React applications, coordinating mitigation, root-cause analysis, and follow-up improvements.
  • Convert incidents, support trends, recurring defects, and performance evidence into prioritized reliability, testability, migration, and maintainability work.

Set the Secure Engineering and Quality Bar

  • Ensure implementations follow approved practices for authentication, authorization, secrets, data access, dependency management, input validation, privacy, and secure coding.
  • Own testing strategy across .NET unit and integration tests, Blazor component and end-to-end tests, and sufficient React test coverage to support maintenance and migration confidence.
  • Ensure CI/CD pipelines apply reliable automated quality gates and provide actionable feedback for both strategic and transitional applications.
  • Balance feature delivery and business continuity with deliberate management of technical debt, security findings, migration risk, and long-term platform simplification.

Coach Engineers and Multiply Capability

  • Coach engineers through design reviews, pairing, pull-request feedback, debugging, migration planning, and targeted delegation.
  • Build shared capability in C#/.NET, Blazor, Azure, React application diagnosis, and controlled migrations so critical knowledge does not remain concentrated in one person.

Contribute Beyond the Immediate Team

  • Partner with Architects and other Technical Leads to establish reusable Blazor patterns and avoid recreating transitional React architectures in new products.
  • Contribute migration lessons, assessment checklists, shared components, standards, and reference implementations that benefit future application transitions.
  • Identify when application capabilities should be consolidated into shared platform services rather than copied during conversion.
  • Represent the team's application-continuity and migration context in cross-team planning and architecture discussions.

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

What Success Looks Like

  • New web development follows coherent C#/.NET, Azure, and Blazor patterns aligned with ai2io standards.
  • Transitional React applications remain stable, supported, secure, observable, and understood while they remain in service.
  • React-to-Blazor migrations use documented priorities, phased plans, clear acceptance criteria, and business-continuity safeguards.
  • Users retain critical capabilities through migration, and retired React components do not leave hidden operational or ownership gaps.
  • Delivery commitments are based on credible decomposition, discovery, dependencies, estimates, and migration risk.

Job Description

A bit about this role:

Here is an amazing opportunity for an ambitious, clinically focused physician ready to practice in Care OnDemand, our virtual urgent care. In this model, you will provide remote, telehealth care to patients in the comfort of their home to avoid unnecessary hospitalizations, while appropriately escalating patients who require care in higher acuity settings. You will also support patients in our virtual observation unit with an interdisciplinary team. You will provide clinical supervision for a team of advanced practice providers practicing remotely across the country. We are building a next generation, value based, urgent care unit to dramatically improve health outcomes on a national scale.

In Care OnDemand, we believe in caring for patients like family. Our motto is: here for you, whenever you need us.

Required skills and experience:

  • Forward-thinking, innovative, clinically outstanding board-certified physician with at least 3 years post-residency experience in any of the following fields: Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Emergency Medicine/Urgent Care.

  • Telehealth experience preferred

  • Multi-state licensure preferred or willingness to obtain additional licensure

  • Adept at learning and utilizing electronic health data and medical record systems, including video, telephonic and AI platforms

  • Eagerness to advocate for care equity and accessibility for vulnerable patient populations.

  • Comfortable with being uncomfortable as we build the care model of the future

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience in acute care settings, including Emergency Department, Urgent Care, hospital medicine or similar settings

  • Experience caring for older adults

  • Experience with population health or value-based care programs

Your Impact will include:

  • Your primary focus (80%) will be to deliver direct care in our virtual urgent care and observation unit. You will provide clinical supervision and teaching to a team of advance practice providers (20%) and foster a collaborative and supportive clinical environment, including leading clinical rounds and offering guidance on challenging scenarios.

  • Fiercely promote our model of caring for patients like family and safeguarding our collaborative team based culture.

  • Deliver exceptional care to patients with urgent care complaints across multiple geographies by leveraging video telehealth visits and a multidisciplinary team to keep them safely at home.

  • Manage patients in our virtual observation unit, to include management of acute-on-chronic exacerbations of disease, adhering to evidence-based practice, thoughtfully incorporating what matters most to patients/families, providing in-depth medication review/ deprescribing and ensuring optimal clinical outcomes.

  • Connect patients with primary care, within and outside Devoted Medical and bridge to comprehensive care programs such as complex care, behavioral health, chronic disease management and palliative care.

  • Fluency in Spanish is a plus, though not required.

Attributes to Success:

  • You are a team leader, recognizing that everyone's success is your success. You love the challenge of working with a variety of patients and facing new challenges every day. You enjoy enabling your team to be empowered to do the best work possible and love sharing your experience, guidance and support with others.

  • You have high standards for the clinical care you provide, you are organized and have meticulous attention to detail. You love learning about and caring for patients and families.

  • You listen to others, you are not afraid to be wrong or change your mind. You lead with curiosity and compassion.

  • You’re a happy warrior - as long as you’re in a great environment with smart, caring people all working together toward a common aim, you’re comfortable working hard.

  • You’re wired for learning and change, you like making a difference, helping to build a better care system by testing and trying new ways of doing things.

  • You have a passion for solving complex problems, and supporting the delivery of healthcare that we would want for our own family members.

  • You enjoy a fast-paced, high-energy, growing organization.

  • Agility and collaboration are critical to your success - we are a new organization and have a start-up mentality. You believe we can do hard things together!

  • You believe in whole-person care and that includes the behavioral component.

Salary Range: $280,500- 338,000 / year

Full-time, salaried position. No overnight work required.

Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package.
